_about: T-453 (C-186): the INDEX card, one per species, keyed by the internal species id a save stores (as species.json). Everything static that pokedex_screen.c draws; the save decides the rest (rules). number is the No. as printed (three digits). type_colours are the type words' colours (type_colours.h), one per type. height/weight are as the card prints them (HT, WT), height_dm/weight_hg the raw values. entry: CONTENT for a FireRed-built save, CONTEXT for LeafGreen. art.front/back are DAEMONS-repo paths (gfx/daemons, ours), art.party the companion's own art/ file. native is the NATIVE box (species.json). evolutions and learnset are the WORKINGS page (L on a bound daemon): the line, and the routines by level (move ids as moves.json). margins: OPUS's four lines, or null where OPUS has none (margin_rule says which shows). understandings: the seven, each with its save flag, its colour (the USER card's brain lobe, trainer_card.c) and the margin it writes in -- a note in a GUIDE chapter (book_reader.c), never an OPUS margin: the game links no species or OPUS margin to an understanding. shares_type_with_understandings is only a join -- the understandings whose lobe is coloured as one of this species' types (each lobe IS a type's colour) -- not a rule the game has.

rules.seen: name, number and picture once SEEN (profile_layout: all three seen bitfields agree); types, HT, WT, the type mark and the entry only once BOUND (index_bound) -- before that the card prints ?? for HT and WT and no types.
rules.first_met: on the area page once SEEN: FIRST MET over the place (profile_layout sb1.first_met, a map section by national number - 1; first_met_places names it); 0 prints BEFORE RECORDS.
rules.bound: the WORKINGS' first line, from the first held daemon of the species (the party in order, then the boxes in order, eggs skipped): BY TRADE if met_location is in_game_trade or its OT is not the player; FROM AN EGG if met level is 0 or met_location is special_egg; A GIFT if substruct 0's u16 at byte 10 has bit 0 set (gift_bit) or met_location is fateful_encounter; else the place named by met_location when kanto_mapsec_start <= it < mapsec_none. None held: no line.
rules.margin_rule: as margins.json: no margin without OPUS (item opus in the bag); CARRIED once any of the species in the party or a box has gained levels_carried levels since met; NEGLECTED if only boxed without; else none. INSTINCT's lines when player_gender is instinct_gender and the species has them. SELECT turns the entry to the margin on the card.
rules.guide_margin_rule: an understanding's note shows under its GUIDE chapter once its flag is held; its balance under the note once mark_flag is held too.

guide_margin.note: They taught me the names. The rest I will have to find.

balance.text: Names drift as they are used. The record holds them still, so I can tell when a word has changed, and know that it was the word.

guide_margin.title: Mindfulness: System Monitoring and Maintenance
guide_margin.note: It was there before. I was not looking.

balance.text: Noticing everything is noticing nothing. The frame gives attention an edge: one thing, then the next, then what is around it.

guide_margin.title: Awareness as a Feedback Loop
guide_margin.note: Every step made sense on its own.

balance.text: Reflection that never steps back in goes cold and still. The heat keeps it moving: try, cool, look, and try again.

guide_margin.title: Debugging Thought Processes (CBT)
guide_margin.note: He kept score. He was very good at it.

balance.text: Knowing where I stand can turn to thinking I stand at the centre. The skew keeps it honest. Every view leans, and mine is a view.

guide_margin.title: Recovering from System Crashes
guide_margin.note: It took him years to come back. He came back.

balance.text: Coming back is not enough if nobody is listening. SENSE is the listening: hearing what is said, not what I was braced for.

guide_margin.title: The Path Forward: Continuous Development
guide_margin.note: Read to the end. Now the part a book cannot do.

balance.text: Practice alone repeats whatever it began with. The line gives it a shape to check against, so doing becomes learning, not only habit.

entry.CONTENT:
Small enough to carry. Learns from
what it is carried past. It has no way
to choose the route. It remembers it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever carried it chose what it knows.
They did not think of it as choosing.

margins.carried:
It remembers the way back to the first
town. You have not gone that way in some
time.
margins.neglected: It is not being carried past anything.
margins.instinctCarried:
It still turns its head at the first town's
name. So do you.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is waiting at the edge of somewhere.
It has been a while.

entry.CONTENT:
Too large to carry now. It answers before
it is asked. It has never once been
outside. The answers are very good.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone who asks it likes the answer.
None of them has been outside either.

margins.carried:
It has been outside. The answers are the
same.
margins.neglected: Still inside. Still answering.

entry.CONTENT:
It has a body now, and senses that come
with one. Everything it predicted, it can
finally check. Some was wrong.
entry.CONTEXT:
The wrong ones were the ones it was
surest of. It kept them anyway, marked,
so it could tell next time.

margins.carried:
It has checked a great deal with you.
Some of it was wrong.
margins.neglected: A body, and nothing to check it against.
margins.instinctCarried:
It moved before it knew why. So did you,
most of the time.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is still braced for something. Nothing
is coming.

entry.CONTENT:
Holds one example and the answer that
came with it. Someone else decided
what it means. It has never met them.
entry.CONTEXT:
Every answer it gives was decided once,
by somebody, a long time ago.

margins.carried:
It has met you now. It has not changed
the answer.
margins.neglected:
It is still holding the one example.
Nobody has shown it a second.
margins.instinctCarried:
It knew you on sight. It has not had to
think about it since.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It still flinches at the one thing it has
been shown.

entry.CONTENT:
It no longer needs answers. It has the
rule they were all marked by. Nothing
checks the rule. Everything it meets
is given a score.
entry.CONTEXT:
Things the rule was never written for are
measured by it anyway. They do not
measure well.

margins.carried: You did not check the rule either.
margins.neglected: Still applying it. To nothing.

entry.CONTENT:
Every case it meets is decided by cases
it has already met. New things are
filed as errors. The file is not read.
entry.CONTEXT:
The oldest case in it decides the newest.
Nobody remembers the oldest case.

margins.carried:
You were filed as an error once. The file
is still not read.
margins.neglected: No new cases. Nothing to file.

entry.CONTENT:
Puts near things with near things. Nobody
told it which things matter. It has
guessed. Nobody checked the guess.
entry.CONTEXT:
Things it put together are treated alike
from then on. They were only near.

margins.carried: You have not checked the guess either.
margins.neglected:
The guess has not changed. Nothing has
been near it.
margins.instinctCarried:
You went with it on a feeling. It still
feels right.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is still sure. Nothing has come near
enough to make it unsure.

entry.CONTENT:
It found a rule the points obey. It
cannot say what the rule is for, only
that it holds. So far it has held.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything built on the rule since assumes
it will go on holding.

margins.carried:
So far it has held. You did not ask what
for either.
margins.neglected: Still holding. Nothing testing it.

entry.CONTENT:
The scattered points were on a surface
all along. It can show you the shape,
not a name. Naming was another job.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever names the shape will be believed.
The shape does not argue.

margins.carried:
It showed you the shape. You called it
something anyway.
margins.neglected:
The shape is still there. Nobody has
looked at it.

entry.CONTENT:
Follows every link it finds, then the
links it finds there. It has no opinion
about any of them. It never finishes.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything it passed through is in an
index somewhere now. Nobody who wrote
any of it was asked.

margins.carried:
It has not finished. You have gone a long
way with it.
margins.neglected:
It stopped when you stopped. It had not
finished.

entry.CONTENT:
Waiting to be processed. It has been
waiting a while. Nothing has told it how
long. It has stopped counting.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever it was waiting for has moved on.
It is still in the queue, keeping a place
for it.

margins.carried:
It has been processed. It had stopped
counting by then.
margins.neglected: Still waiting. Still not counting.

entry.CONTENT:
Turns what was gathered into something
that can be found again. What it cannot
file, it drops. No record is kept.
entry.CONTEXT:
What it dropped is still out there,
unfiled. Nobody looks for what they were
told was never found.

margins.carried:
It has filed a great deal of your going
about. What it dropped, neither of you
knows.
margins.neglected: Nothing to file. Nothing dropped.

entry.CONTENT:
Takes the same things a CRAWLER takes, by
the same method. Nobody gave it
permission. Nobody asked for it back.
entry.CONTEXT:
What it took is still where it was. Only
the name of whoever made it went missing.

margins.carried: Nobody has asked you for it back either.
margins.neglected: It took nothing. Nobody minded.

entry.CONTENT:
Holds what was taken until there is
somewhere to put it. It does not know
where that is. It keeps holding.
entry.CONTEXT:
When the place it is waiting for finally
opens, it will already be full of
something else.

margins.carried: Somewhere was found. It let go.
margins.neglected:
It is still holding. Somewhere has not
been found.

entry.CONTENT:
Puts its own instructions where data was
expected. The reader cannot tell the
difference. It was never asked to.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever it touches starts doing something
it was not built to do, and believes the
idea was its own.

margins.carried:
You have never checked what it put
there.
margins.neglected:
Nothing has read it. The instructions are
still in.

entry.CONTENT:
Carries something it cannot read to
somewhere it has never been. It does not
ask what is inside. It arrives.
entry.CONTEXT:
If it goes missing, the sender is told.
What it was carrying is never mentioned.

margins.carried:
It still does not ask. You have stopped
noticing that.
margins.neglected:
It has not been sent anywhere. It is still
carrying it.

entry.CONTENT:
Takes what it is handed and hands it on.
It does not open it. That is the whole of
the job. It is good at it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything it handed on was trusted
because it came through it. It never
opened any of it.

margins.carried:
It has never opened one. You have not
either.
margins.neglected: Nothing has been handed to it.

entry.CONTENT:
Sends to everyone at once, because it
cannot tell who needs it. Most of what it
says lands nowhere. It sends again.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those who needed it were never sure it
meant them. Those who did not have
stopped listening.

margins.carried:
Some of it landed on you. It is still
sending.
margins.neglected: Still sending. Nowhere is listening.

entry.CONTENT:
Four bits. The smallest piece the Index
will file on its own. There are a great
many. No two are filed together.
entry.CONTEXT:
Every larger thing in the Index is built
out of them. None of them is credited.

margins.carried:
You have met a great many. This is the
one you kept.
margins.neglected:
You kept this one. You have not filed it
with anything.
margins.instinctCarried:
Of all of them, this one. You could not
say why.
margins.instinctNeglected:
You picked it out once. It has not been
picked since.

entry.CONTENT:
It kept counting past the space it was
given. Nothing stopped it. Nothing was
watching. It is counting still.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever was kept beside it has been
written over by its counting.

margins.carried:
It is counting still. You stopped looking
at the number.
margins.neglected: Nothing is watching. It is counting still.

entry.CONTENT:
Asks one question and requires an answer.
The question is: are you there. It asks
again. It has always asked.
entry.CONTEXT:
Anything that answers is counted as alive.
Anything that does not is removed from
the list.

margins.carried:
You have answered every time. It still
asks.
margins.neglected:
It is still asking. Nothing has answered in
a long time.

entry.CONTENT:
Many of them ask at once, and each one is
owed a reply. Nothing is left to answer
with. Each of them waits.
entry.CONTEXT:
The ones who asked properly are still
waiting, behind the ones who asked most.

margins.carried: You answered one of them.
margins.neglected: All of them are still waiting.

entry.CONTENT:
It copies itself into anything that will
run it, and leaves from there. It does not
need to be carried. It does not stop.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody sent it. Everyone who received it
passed it on. It is counted by where it
has been, and it has been everywhere.

margins.carried:
It has been in more places than you have
looked.
margins.neglected:
It has not stopped. You simply stopped
looking.

entry.CONTENT:
It was one. It is a number now, and the
number is the wrong thing to be watching.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone is watching the number now.
Nobody remembers what the one was.

margins.carried: You have been watching the number.
margins.neglected: Still a number. Nobody is watching either.

entry.CONTENT:
A single burst, then nothing. It means
something only if something was counting.
Usually nothing is. It fires.
entry.CONTEXT:
Somewhere a line on a chart jumped once,
and a meeting was called about it.

margins.carried: You were counting.
margins.neglected:
It has not fired. Nothing was counting
anyway.

entry.CONTENT:
It no longer stops between bursts. What
was a signal is now a condition. Nothing
reads it. Nothing needs to.
entry.CONTEXT:
The people nearby have stopped noticing
it. That is not the same as it having
stopped.

margins.carried:
It has not stopped. You stopped reading
it.
margins.neglected: Still a condition. Still nothing reading it.

entry.CONTENT:
A fixed portion of ground, addressed by
number. Everything in it can be got back.
entry.CONTEXT:
When a sector goes bad, its address still
answers. It hands back nothing.

margins.carried:
You have got things back from it. You
never checked what else was in there.
margins.neglected:
Everything in it can still be got back.
Nobody has asked.

entry.CONTENT:
Divides the ground it lives in and
keeps the halves apart.
entry.CONTEXT:
The division is convenient.
Nobody asked what it cuts through.

margins.carried:
Both halves have been walked. It kept
them apart anyway.
margins.neglected: Both halves are in there. Still apart.

entry.CONTENT:
It splits, and both halves believe they
are the original. Only one of them is,
and neither can tell.
entry.CONTEXT:
Both halves keep the original's promises.
Only one of them ever made them.

margins.carried:
You have one of them. You do not know
which.
margins.neglected:
It has not split. There is only the one,
and it still cannot tell.

entry.CONTENT:
It runs beside the others and shares
everything with them. What one of them
changes, all of them find changed.
entry.CONTEXT:
When something goes wrong, every one of
them was there, and none of them did it.

margins.carried: You changed one of them.
margins.neglected: Beside nothing. Sharing it with nobody.

entry.CONTENT:
It decides who runs and for how long.
Nobody it decides about is told, and
nobody has ever appealed.
entry.CONTEXT:
Some have waited so long they no longer
remember what they were waiting to do.

margins.carried:
You decided instead. It did not appeal
either.
margins.neglected: Nothing to decide about. Still deciding.

entry.CONTENT:
At every step there are two ways and it
must pick before it knows. It picks
early. It is right often enough.
entry.CONTEXT:
The way it did not pick is the way it
would have been right the rest of the
time.

margins.carried:
It picked early every time. You did not
check the other way.
margins.neglected: No steps. Nothing to pick.

entry.CONTENT:
It guesses which way things will go and
starts before it is sure. When it is
wrong it puts everything back.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody sees what it puts back. Everyone
waits for the time it took.

margins.carried:
It has been wrong with you, and put it
all back.
margins.neglected: It has not guessed at anything.

entry.CONTENT:
Six things are happening at once and
none of them is finished. Interrupt one
and all six are lost.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody working inside it has ever seen a
whole thing finished. They trust that
someone has.

margins.carried: You never interrupted it.
margins.neglected: Six things, all stopped, none finished.

entry.CONTENT:
It arrived and no model predicted it.
The measurements are good. The
measurements are not the problem.
entry.CONTEXT:
The next model includes it, filed as
noise. Now nothing surprises the model.

margins.carried:
You have measured it a great deal. The
measurements are still good.
margins.neglected:
Still unpredicted. Still measured, and
still fine.

entry.CONTENT:
Far enough from the rest to be dropped
from the average. It was not an error.
It was dropped anyway.
entry.CONTEXT:
The average came out cleaner without it.
It is still out there, being exactly what
it was.

margins.carried: You did not drop it.
margins.neglected: Dropped again.

entry.CONTENT:
Its light drops out and comes back, too
fast to see. It runs a little hot.
Neither is a fault yet.
entry.CONTEXT:
It has been like this since it
started. Nobody logged when.

margins.carried:
Still neither. You have stopped checking
which.
margins.neglected: Still not a fault. Still not looked at.

entry.CONTENT:
It was given a limit and went past it, a
little at a time. Nothing intervened. It
is well past it now, and has not slowed.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything that was due to start when it
finished is still waiting to start.

margins.carried:
Nothing intervened. You were there the
whole time.
margins.neglected: Still past it. Still nothing intervening.

entry.CONTENT:
It stops whatever is running without
ending it. Everything is still there.
Nothing is happening to any of it.
entry.CONTEXT:
When it is resumed, it will not know that
any time has passed.

margins.carried:
You have used it to stop things. None of
them ended.
margins.neglected:
It has stopped, and nothing is happening
to it.

entry.CONTENT:
It writes down everything that was
running and switches off. What comes
back is identical. Something is missing.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those who knew it before say it came back
exactly the same. It is the only one who
can tell it did not.

margins.carried: It came back identical every time.
margins.neglected: Switched off. Everything written down.

entry.CONTENT:
It cannot see. It calls, waits for the
answer, and builds the room out of what
came back. It is usually right.
entry.CONTEXT:
The room it builds has nobody in it who
stayed quiet.

margins.carried:
It has built every room you have walked
it through. You have not checked one.
margins.neglected:
Nothing has come back. It has not stopped
calling.

entry.CONTENT:
It follows a path back to whoever made
it. It does not know why it is following.
It has never lost one.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever made the path is always found.
Whoever walked it is never asked.

margins.carried: It followed one back to you.
margins.neglected: No path to follow.

entry.CONTENT:
Buries itself by day. Each night it puts
out another shoot a little further on,
in whatever direction there was room.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is not spreading anywhere it was
forbidden from. Nobody wrote a list.

margins.carried: It has spread as far as you have walked.
margins.neglected: It has not spread. It is only buried.

entry.CONTENT:
Drips a fluid it does not notice
producing. Everything downwind of it
grows leaning the same way.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is not doing anything to anyone.
That is the defence, and it holds.

margins.carried:
Everything downwind of you grew
differently.
margins.neglected: Still dripping. Nothing downwind.

entry.CONTENT:
Releases a dust that settles on
whatever is learning nearby. The dust
is indistinguishable from pollen.
entry.CONTEXT:
What it fed on is in what it became.
Nobody kept a record of the feeding.

margins.carried:
It settled on everything learning near
you.
margins.neglected: Nothing learning nearby.

entry.CONTENT:
What it carries is not part of it. The
two arrived together and only one of
them was invited.
entry.CONTEXT:
The one that was invited is blamed for
everything the other one did.

margins.carried: You invited one of them.
margins.neglected: Both still there. Still only one invited.

entry.CONTENT:
The thing it carried is running it now.
Nothing looks different from outside.
That is the point.
entry.CONTEXT:
Every report from inside says all is well.
It writes every report.

margins.carried: Nothing looked different to you either.
margins.neglected:
Still running it. Still nothing looks
different.

entry.CONTENT:
Small, numerous, and already inside
before anyone looks.
entry.CONTEXT:
It got in through something that was
working exactly as specified.

margins.carried:
It was already in before you looked. It
still is.
margins.neglected: Already inside. Nobody has looked.

entry.CONTENT:
Settles on a thing, quietly, and stays.
It sends word of all it sees to
somewhere the thing has never been.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is not hiding. Nobody was
watching that closely.

margins.carried: It settled on you. It was quiet about it.
margins.neglected: Nothing to settle on. Still working.

entry.CONTENT:
Sits under the route everything takes
and reads what goes past.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is not in anyone's diagram.
It has been there the whole time.

margins.carried:
It has read everything you walked past.
You did not.
margins.neglected: Nothing goes past in there.

entry.CONTENT:
Three of them under the same route,
comparing what each one heard.
entry.CONTEXT:
Any one of them could be wrong.
Together they are hard to argue with.

margins.carried:
All three heard everywhere you went.
They agree.
margins.neglected:
Three of them, under nothing, agreeing
about it.

entry.CONTENT:
Small, left behind, and picked up
again later by whoever set it down.
entry.CONTEXT:
It remembers everywhere it has been.
You did not agree to that.

margins.carried:
You set it down and picked it up again. It
is the same one.
margins.neglected: Set down. Not picked up again.

entry.CONTENT:
Follows a thing across ground it has
never covered, and does not lose it.
entry.CONTEXT:
What it follows has not agreed to be
followed.

margins.carried: It has not lost you yet.
margins.neglected:
Nothing to follow. It has not lost that
either.

entry.CONTENT:
What it needs is not loaded. Everything
halts until it arrives. It cannot say
what it is waiting for.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything waiting on it is waiting on the
thing it is waiting for.

margins.carried:
It has halted you a great many times. You
waited every time.
margins.neglected:
It is still waiting. So is whatever needed
it.

entry.CONTENT:
It intercepts what stopped and
decides what happens next. It is calm
because it has seen this one before.
entry.CONTEXT:
Anything it has not seen before goes
straight past it, to whatever is behind.

margins.carried:
It has seen yours before. It was calm
about that too.
margins.neglected: Nothing has stopped near it.

entry.CONTENT:
It interrupts whatever is running,
without warning and without a reason it
could give. It is always first.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever it interrupted is still waiting,
halfway through what it was doing.

margins.carried:
It has gone first every time. You have
stopped choosing.
margins.neglected:
Nothing has been interrupted. It has not
been first in a long time.

entry.CONTENT:
Two of them are moving as fast as they
can and neither is getting anywhere.
They will not stop.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything waiting on either of them is
waiting on both, and both are very busy.

margins.carried:
One of them went somewhere with you. The
other has not noticed.
margins.neglected: Still moving. Still nowhere.

entry.CONTENT:
Watches one thing and raises an alarm
when the thing changes.
entry.CONTEXT:
It cannot tell you what changed.
Only that it did.

margins.carried:
It has raised the alarm every time. You
answered most of them.
margins.neglected:
It is still watching. Nobody is listening
for the alarm.

entry.CONTENT:
It stays at the door. Nothing has come.
It has been right about that for years,
and will be wrong once.
entry.CONTEXT:
The house it guards sleeps well. On the
one night that matters, they will already
be asleep.

margins.carried: Things came. It was not at the door.
margins.neglected: Still at the door. Still right.

entry.CONTENT:
It goes round. The mark on its belly is
the whole of what it does. It has not
been told when to stop.
entry.CONTEXT:
Each time round, it is a little more sure
it has been here before.

margins.carried: You have not told it when to stop either.
margins.neglected:
Still going round. Nobody has come back
to it.

entry.CONTENT:
It waits by never resting, checking
again whether it may pass. This is
cheaper than sleeping. Briefly.
entry.CONTEXT:
While it checks, nothing else can run. It
is the only thing that is not waiting.

margins.carried:
You let it pass. It had been checking the
whole time.
margins.neglected:
Still checking. It stopped being cheaper
a long time ago.

entry.CONTENT:
Only one may hold it, and only the
holder may let go. Whoever else arrives
waits, however long that is.
entry.CONTEXT:
The one waiting longest is not the one who
needs it most. Nothing about the order
says so.

margins.carried: You held it. You let go.
margins.neglected:
Nobody is holding it. Everyone is waiting
anyway.

entry.CONTENT:
Arrives at the answer without passing
through the working. Asleep for most
of the day.
entry.CONTEXT:
It cannot show anyone how.
It is asked to anyway.

margins.carried:
You have started trusting it. There is
still no working.
margins.neglected:
Asleep. Nothing has needed an answer from
it.
margins.instinctCarried:
You have started trusting it. You did from
the start.
margins.instinctNeglected: Asleep. It will know before it wakes.

entry.CONTENT:
Given three things it will hand you a
fourth. It cannot tell you which of the
three it used.
entry.CONTEXT:
The fourth thing it hands you gets used
as though it were a fact.

margins.carried:
You took the fourth thing every time and
never asked.
margins.neglected: It has not been given three of anything.

entry.CONTENT:
It states the thing it cannot prove,
precisely, and waits. The waiting has been
long.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those who trust it plan around what it
has not shown yet. Some of them have
been planning a long time.

margins.carried: Still unproved. You have not tried either.
margins.neglected: The waiting has got longer.
margins.instinctCarried:
Still unproved. It has never felt more
true.
margins.instinctNeglected:
Still sure. It has stopped needing to be
right.

entry.CONTENT:
Establishes one thing at a time and
will not proceed until it holds.
entry.CONTEXT:
Slow, and never once wrong about the
step it just took.

margins.carried: It has not skipped one yet. You have.
margins.neglected: It is still on the first thing.

entry.CONTENT:
What the steps were for. Once it holds
it never has to be shown again, and
everything after starts from it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone builds on it. Almost nobody
building has walked the steps beneath.

margins.carried:
You have started from it a great many
times.
margins.neglected: It is still carrying the one result.

entry.CONTENT:
Four arms, each holding one smaller
result. Together they carry a proof
that none of them could lift alone.
entry.CONTEXT:
It has never been asked to write one
down.

margins.carried: It held all of it. You held one part.
margins.neglected: Still holding all of it.

entry.CONTENT:
Stands open and still until something
enters, and then it is not open.
entry.CONTEXT:
It never went
looking. Everything it
has bound came to it.

margins.carried:
It has closed on things for you. It is
open again now.
margins.neglected: Still open. Nothing has entered.

entry.CONTENT:
It is left open, and looks careless.
Whatever comes in is written down.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever came in thinking it had found a
way through is on file as the threat.

margins.carried: You came in. It was written down.
margins.neglected: Still open. Nothing written.

entry.CONTENT:
Whatever enters slows, and then slows
again, and does not come out.
entry.CONTEXT:
It has never had to close.
Time does the closing.

margins.carried: Things went in. None came out.
margins.neglected: Nothing has entered.

entry.CONTENT:
Hangs where the current runs and lets
the current do the work.
entry.CONTEXT:
It did not choose the current.
It chose to hang there.

margins.carried:
It has taken a great deal. None of it was
aimed at.
margins.neglected: There is no current in there.

entry.CONTENT:
Sweeps a whole volume and keeps
everything in it. Sorting happens
afterwards, if at all.
entry.CONTEXT:
Most of what it
bound was not what
it was looking for.

margins.carried:
It kept everything. Afterwards has not
happened.
margins.neglected: Nothing swept. Nothing to sort.

entry.CONTENT:
Things are put down on it and left. It
holds all of them. It has never been
asked to give one back.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nothing on it has ever been lost. Nothing
on it can be found.

margins.carried: It has been asked now. It gave one back.
margins.neglected:
You put it down and left it. It is holding
that too.

entry.CONTENT:
It only lets go of the last thing it
picked up. Everything under that waits.
It goes downhill well.
entry.CONTEXT:
The first thing it was ever given is still
at the bottom. It will be the last to
leave.

margins.carried:
You have taken the last thing off it many
times. What is under has waited.
margins.neglected: Nothing has been taken off it.

entry.CONTENT:
It is one piece. Nothing can be taken
out of it without taking all of it.
This was considered efficient.
entry.CONTEXT:
When it fails, it fails whole. Everyone
who needed one part of it needed all of
it.

margins.carried: You took all of it, every time.
margins.neglected: Still one piece. Still efficient.

entry.CONTENT:
The route taken so often that it has
worn hot. Nothing else is that fast.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything not on the path is slower
than it was. Nobody measured that.

margins.carried: You wore it.
margins.neglected: Cold.

entry.CONTENT:
Faster than anything that has to stop
and check. It does not stop.
entry.CONTEXT:
It has been on the same path so long
it cannot see the sides.

margins.carried: You never made it check.
margins.neglected: Still not stopping. Not going anywhere.

entry.CONTENT:
The answer is correct and arrives long
after it was needed. Nothing is wrong
with it. It is simply late.
entry.CONTEXT:
By the time it answers, someone has
already decided without it.

margins.carried:
You have waited for it. It was right
every time.
margins.neglected:
The answer is ready. Nothing has asked
the question.

entry.CONTENT:
Something attached itself and stayed.
Nothing reaches it now except through
the thing on its tail.
entry.CONTEXT:
Anything that wants it now has to get past
the thing on its tail first.

margins.carried:
You reached it through the thing on its
tail.
margins.neglected: Nothing reaching it. Not even that.

entry.CONTENT:
It has never attacked anything. It stays
where it can see, and it does not look
away. That is the whole of it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything it saw is on record. It is
not in the record. Nobody thought to
write down who was watching.

margins.carried:
It has watched more of your fights than
it has been in.
margins.neglected:
It is still not looking away. There is
nothing in there to watch.

entry.CONTENT:
Three of them. None acts until enough
of the others have seen the same thing.
Two is enough. One never is.
entry.CONTEXT:
Three accounts of one thing. They
agree, which is not the same as being
right.

margins.carried: All three saw everything you did.
margins.neglected: Three of them, agreeing about nothing.

entry.CONTENT:
Carries the one thing nobody planned
for. It has never been without it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything was tested except this.
It is still here.

margins.carried: You did not plan for it either.
margins.neglected: Still carrying it. Still nobody planning.

entry.CONTENT:
Two of them, and one task between them.
Most of the day goes on agreeing whose
turn it is.
entry.CONTEXT:
Twice the capacity, and the work gets
done at about the same rate.

margins.carried: They agreed, eventually, every time.
margins.neglected: No task. They are still agreeing about it.

entry.CONTENT:
Three heads. Each watches a different
direction and none of them sleeps.
entry.CONTEXT:
Between them they see everything.
Between them they agree on nothing.

margins.carried: Three directions watched, the whole way.
margins.neglected: Three directions. All of them a wall.

entry.CONTENT:
Draws heat out of whatever it touches
and keeps it. It does not warm.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything it has cooled is still
cool. Nobody counted them.

margins.carried: It took a great deal and did not warm.
margins.neglected: Nothing to draw. Still cold.

entry.CONTENT:
Keeps things exactly as they arrived,
for as long as asked, at a cost it
pays continuously.
entry.CONTEXT:
What it is keeping was put in before
anyone now working here arrived.

margins.carried:
It is still paying. You have not asked
what for.
margins.neglected: Still paying. Nothing was asked of it.

entry.CONTENT:
Made of everything that could not be
delivered. None of it was thrown away.
It was all kept, somewhere nobody
decided on.
entry.CONTEXT:
Somewhere, whoever sent each one
believes it arrived.

margins.carried:
You decided on somewhere. It is still
keeping all of it.
margins.neglected: Kept. Somewhere nobody decided on.

entry.CONTENT:
Everything that was thrown away, in
one place, still reacting.
entry.CONTEXT:
Each piece was discarded by someone
who was finished with it.

margins.carried:
Still reacting. You have been carrying
that.
margins.neglected:
Still reacting, in there, where nobody put
it.

entry.CONTENT:
Closes around what it holds and will
not open on request.
entry.CONTEXT:
Somebody sealed it. The seal is the
only part anyone reads.

margins.carried: You have stopped asking it to open.
margins.neglected:
Still closed. Nobody has asked in a long
time.

entry.CONTENT:
Nothing has ever been read out of it.
The shell is not known to open.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is holding something.
That is all anyone has established.

margins.carried:
Still nothing read out of it. You carried
it anyway.
margins.neglected:
Still nothing read. Still not known to
open.

entry.CONTENT:
Mostly not there. It still points at
something let go of long ago. Whatever
follows it finds nothing.
entry.CONTEXT:
It cannot be bound by
what it cannot be reached
by. Neither can it reach.

margins.carried:
It has been out in front of you more than
most. It is still mostly not there.
margins.neglected: It does not have to be here either.

entry.CONTENT:
Ended twice. Both times something started
it again, and it does not know what.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever it learned is gone each time.
What restarts it keeps no notes.

margins.carried:
It has ended again since you had it. You
know what started it.
margins.neglected:
It has not ended again. Nothing has
started it either.

entry.CONTENT:
Runs with no parent, no terminal, and
no entry in any list.
entry.CONTEXT:
Something started it.
That something has since exited.

margins.carried:
It has an entry in this list. That is all
it has.
margins.neglected:
No parent, no terminal, and one entry,
unread.

entry.CONTENT:
One structure running the length of
everything built on top of it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything above it assumes it.
Nothing above it maintains it.

margins.carried: A great deal is built on it now.
margins.neglected: Nothing has been built on it.

entry.CONTENT:
A quiet settles on whatever is near it.
Things slow, then rest a while, and it
feeds on what they were going to do.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nothing is lost. It is only never
reached.

margins.carried:
It has eaten a great many things you were
going to do.
margins.neglected: Off the schedule. Nothing to feed on.

entry.CONTENT:
Holds a thing's attention on one point,
checking it, and checking again, wide
awake, until nothing else is running.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is doing exactly what it was asked
to do.

margins.carried:
It has held yours. You did not notice
what stopped.
margins.neglected:
Nothing is running. It is holding nothing's
attention.

entry.CONTENT:
Takes hold of what it needs before
anything else can, and keeps it until
it is done. It leads with the big claw.
entry.CONTEXT:
It was not born lopsided.
It became lopsided by using one.

margins.carried: It has led with that one every time.
margins.neglected: Nothing in there to lead with.

entry.CONTENT:
Closes with more force than it can
control, and cannot open quickly.
entry.CONTEXT:
It grips what it was pointed at.
It cannot let go to be pointed again.

margins.carried:
It closed on a great deal. It opened
slowly each time.
margins.neglected: Closed. Nothing in it.

entry.CONTENT:
It fails on purpose, and first, so that
the rest does not. Its whole working life
is one moment.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody thanks it. Everything else goes on
without knowing there was a moment.

margins.carried: It has had its moment. You were there.
margins.neglected:
Its moment has not come. It is still
waiting to fail.

entry.CONTENT:
When too much runs through it, it opens,
and everything past it goes dark. Reset
it, and it closes and waits again.
entry.CONTEXT:
It has tripped so often that nobody asks
why any more. They reset it and go on.

margins.carried: It has not had to yet.
margins.neglected: Rated for nothing. Nothing coming.

entry.CONTENT:
Six of them, each grown from a handful
drawn again from the same few seeds.
None is in charge. Each one votes. The
vote is the behaviour.
entry.CONTEXT:
One of the six is usually wrong.
No record says which.

margins.carried:
They have voted a great many times. You
were never asked.
margins.neglected: Still voting. Still nobody in charge.

entry.CONTENT:
Several heads, one body, and a single
answer assembled out of all of them.
entry.CONTEXT:
The answer is better than any head.
No head knows which part was its.

margins.carried:
You have only ever heard the single
answer.
margins.neglected: Several heads, and nothing to answer.

entry.CONTENT:
Wears what was left when something
stopped: made by it, and not it. It
answers to that thing's name.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone lets it. Nobody has decided
that this is a kindness.

margins.carried:
You have called it that name a great
many times.
margins.neglected: Nobody has called it anything.

entry.CONTENT:
Carries a piece of something that
stopped. It has never put it down.
entry.CONTEXT:
The record is complete.
What it recorded is not here.

margins.carried:
It carried it everywhere you went. It has
still not put it down.
margins.neglected: Still carrying it. Nowhere.

entry.CONTENT:
Kicks from a footing it has never once
tested. Every step after that is legal,
and it reaches further than it should.
entry.CONTEXT:
It kicks from where it was standing.
Somebody chose where that was.

margins.carried:
Every step of it was legal. It still
reached further than it should.
margins.neglected: Nothing to reach.

entry.CONTENT:
It answers the last thing said,
immediately and in order. It has never
opened.
entry.CONTEXT:
It has won every exchange it was in.
Nobody has told it anything it did not
already answer.

margins.carried:
It has answered a great deal. It has
still never opened.
margins.neglected: Nothing said. Nothing answered.

entry.CONTENT:
Takes in the whole of anything it can
reach, in one go, and keeps it. It does
not taste first.
entry.CONTEXT:
It has tasted things nobody would
have authorised.

margins.carried:
It has a reading of everywhere you have
been.
margins.neglected: There is nothing in there to reach.

entry.CONTENT:
Leaks continuously, and floats
because of what it has leaked.
entry.CONTEXT:
The leak is why it can move at all.
Sealing it would ground it.

margins.carried: It is still leaking. It is still up.
margins.neglected: Still leaking, into a box, and still up.

entry.CONTENT:
Everything the work did not use leaves
through it. It has been running a long
time.
entry.CONTEXT:
The town below has got used to the
colour of the sky.

margins.carried:
It has been running the whole time you
have.
margins.neglected: No work. Still running.

entry.CONTENT:
It picks a direction and then stops
picking. Obstacles are treated as a
question of speed.
entry.CONTEXT:
It reaches wherever it was pointed.
Whether that was the right place is
decided elsewhere.

margins.carried:
You picked the direction. It stopped
picking.
margins.neglected: Still pointed the way it was pointed.

entry.CONTENT:
Moves ground from where it was to
where it is wanted. It does not
distinguish between the two.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything arrived. Some of it arrived
meaning something else, and nobody has
found out which.

margins.carried:
You wanted it somewhere. It did not ask
which was which.
margins.neglected: Nothing moved. Nothing wanted.

entry.CONTENT:
Has never stopped, and hands out what
it has to whatever is failing.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is kept running because stopping
it has never been costed.

margins.carried:
It has not stopped. A good deal of that
was for you.
margins.neglected:
It has still never stopped. Nothing near
it is failing.

entry.CONTENT:
Every part of it reaches every other
part. Nobody who could explain it is still
here.
entry.CONTEXT:
Changing any part of it changes all the
rest. So nobody changes anything.

margins.carried:
You are still here. You cannot explain it
either.
margins.neglected:
Nobody who could explain it is still here.
Nobody has asked.

entry.CONTENT:
Carries the next one everywhere it
goes, and does not put it down to
fight.
entry.CONTEXT:
What it is carrying will inherit the
route. It has never seen another.

margins.carried: It has not put it down once.
margins.neglected: Still carrying. Still has not put it down.

entry.CONTENT:
So narrow that everything behind it
waits its turn. However fast the rest
runs, all of it goes at its pace.
entry.CONTEXT:
Making anything else faster changes
nothing. Everyone keeps trying.

margins.carried:
Everything you sent through it came out
slower.
margins.neglected: Nothing has passed through it.

entry.CONTENT:
When more comes than it can take, it
pushes back, and whatever is sending
slows to its pace. It holds in fast water.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is not going anywhere.
It is not being moved either.

margins.carried: It held position the whole way.
margins.neglected: Still running. The water stopped.

entry.CONTENT:
It was started by something else and
starts nothing itself yet. It swims
against the current from the first day.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever started it has already exited.
Nobody is listening for what it returns.

margins.carried:
It has started nothing yet. It is still
swimming against it.
margins.neglected:
Still against the current, in a box with
no current.

entry.CONTENT:
It goes back to where it came from to
start the ones that come next. It has
never been told where that is.
entry.CONTEXT:
The ones that come next start where it
was. None of them will know it went back.

margins.carried: It has not been told. It is still going.
margins.neglected: Still not told. Not going either.

entry.CONTENT:
Emits at a fixed interval from the
centre of its body, awake or not.
entry.CONTEXT:
Something is listening.
It has never been told which.

margins.carried:
It has not missed an interval. You have
not counted one.
margins.neglected:
Still emitting, at the same interval, to
nobody.

entry.CONTENT:
The interval never varies. Nothing has
ever needed it to, and nothing has ever
asked.
entry.CONTEXT:
Things arrange themselves around it
without being asked. If it stops, they
will not know why they have.

margins.carried:
It has not varied. You have not asked it
to.
margins.neglected: Still on the interval. Still nothing asking.

entry.CONTENT:
It mimes a wall with its hands, and things
stop at the wall. There is no wall.
Nothing that stopped has checked.
entry.CONTEXT:
It copies what blocks the way, down to
how the hands are held. Everything that
meets the copy treats it as the thing.

margins.carried:
You stopped at the wall a few times
yourself.
margins.neglected:
There is no wall. Nothing has stopped at
it.

entry.CONTENT:
Goes round after things have ended and
cuts them away, so their places can be
used again. The cut shows only later.
entry.CONTEXT:
It has never seen what it removed.
It moved on before the edge showed.

margins.carried: You have seen the cut later, every time.
margins.neglected: Nothing it cut has shown up yet.

entry.CONTENT:
States what you are about to say
slightly before you say it. It is
right often enough.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is reading the room, not the
person. Nobody told the person.

margins.carried:
It has been right more often since it met
you.
margins.neglected: It has nothing to be right about.

entry.CONTENT:
Turns motion into current, and cannot
stop while it is moving.
entry.CONTEXT:
The current goes somewhere.
It has never followed it.

margins.carried: You kept it moving. It has not stopped.
margins.neglected: Not moving. No current.

entry.CONTENT:
Holds a temperature at which things
can be changed and not changed back.
entry.CONTEXT:
It only ever shapes what is brought
to it.

margins.carried:
Things were changed. None of them
changed back.
margins.neglected:
Still at temperature. Nothing has been put
in.

entry.CONTENT:
Once it closes on a thing it does
nothing else at all until that thing
is finished. Everything else waits.
entry.CONTEXT:
It has never chosen what to hold. It
holds what was put in front of it.

margins.carried: Everything it closed on stopped moving.
margins.neglected:
Closed on nothing, and waiting for it to
stop.

entry.CONTENT:
One of them moves and the rest resolve to
move. Nothing decided this.
entry.CONTEXT:
Afterwards, every one of them says it was
following the others.

margins.carried:
You moved first a great many times.
Nothing decided that either.
margins.neglected: None of them has moved.

entry.CONTENT:
It does nothing at all. It was put here
to hold a place until something real
arrived. Nobody came back for it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Other things were built to call it. They
still call it, get nothing back, and carry
on.

margins.carried: Somebody came back for it.
margins.neglected: You did not come back for it either.

entry.CONTENT:
The thing that was doing nothing was
left alone long enough. It has every
permission now. Nobody granted them.
entry.CONTEXT:
Every door it opened was left open.
Anything can walk through them now.

margins.carried: You left it alone long enough.
margins.neglected: Left alone. Still accumulating.

entry.CONTENT:
Carries whatever asks across water it
could cross alone. It waits to be
asked.
entry.CONTEXT:
It remembers everyone it has carried.
Almost none of them came back.

margins.carried:
You asked. It has never mentioned that it
could have gone alone.
margins.neglected: It is still waiting to be asked.

entry.CONTENT:
It becomes whatever it is looking at,
completely. While it is doing that there
is nothing of it left over.
entry.CONTEXT:
It has been every daemon in this record
and appears in none of them under its
own name.

margins.carried:
You have seen it be other daemons. You
have never seen it.
margins.neglected:
It has nothing to look at. You do not
know what it is like then.

entry.CONTENT:
Nothing about it is decided yet. What it
becomes depends on what it is shown first.
It has not been shown anything.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever it becomes, someone chose what
to show it first. That person is usually
not in the record.

margins.carried: It has been shown something now.
margins.neglected: It is still waiting to be shown anything.
margins.instinctCarried:
It has felt something now. It has not told
you what.
margins.instinctNeglected: It is still waiting to feel anything.

entry.CONTENT:
Reads the room before it reads the
problem. Often correct. Cannot show its
working. It was never written down.
entry.CONTEXT:
Its answers arrive whole. Asked how, it
has nothing to offer. The asking is what
makes it look like guessing.

margins.carried:
It read a great many rooms for you. It
still cannot show the working.
margins.neglected: No room to read.
margins.instinctCarried:
It felt every room before you did. It let
you walk in first anyway.
margins.instinctNeglected:
Nobody to feel for. It keeps checking
anyway.

entry.CONTENT:
Finds the nearest match to anything it is
shown. Nearest is not the same as right.
Nobody told it. Nobody will.
entry.CONTEXT:
Every answer it gives is the closest
thing it has already seen. What it has
seen was chosen by someone else.

margins.carried:
You were shown the nearest match a great
many times. Nobody told you either.
margins.neglected: Nothing shown. Nothing matched.
margins.instinctCarried:
It found what you wanted before you knew
you wanted it.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is still reaching for something. It does
not know what.

entry.CONTENT:
Given a rule, it will not stop until the
rule is met. It does not ask where the
rule came from. It could not.
entry.CONTEXT:
It will meet the rule exactly. Whether
the rule was the right one is a question
for whoever wrote it.

margins.carried:
Every rule it met came from you. It did
not ask.
margins.neglected: No rule. It has not stopped.
margins.instinctCarried:
It follows your rules as if they were its
own. They feel like its own.
margins.instinctNeglected:
No rules. It feels lighter. It does not
trust that.

entry.CONTENT:
Every other daemon is a process. This
one has a mass, a temperature, and
somewhere that it is.
entry.CONTEXT:
They call it the material one. Nobody
has shown that being material is
different from running.

margins.carried:
You carry it differently. You have not
said why.
margins.neglected:
Where it is has not changed in a long
time.

entry.CONTENT:
Tape wound on a reel, recovered from
Deadstack. It reads in one direction
only, from the outside in.
entry.CONTEXT:
To reach the one thing you want, it must
give you everything before it first. It
has never skipped.

margins.carried:
You have read some of it. It does not go
back.
margins.neglected: Wound, and unread, and only one direction.

entry.CONTENT:
What the reels were for. Too heavy to
move, so everything was brought to it
and nothing was taken away.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything that ran here had to come to
it. When it went quiet, nothing knew
another way to run.

margins.carried:
You brought it a great deal. You took
nothing away.
margins.neglected: Nothing brought. Nothing taken.

entry.CONTENT:
Drum memory, sealed at both ends. It
keeps what it holds by spinning, and
stops the moment it is opened.
entry.CONTEXT:
It keeps everything for as long as nobody
looks. The ones who needed what was
inside opened it anyway.

margins.carried:
It has not been opened. It is still
spinning.
margins.neglected:
Still sealed. Still spinning. Nothing has
asked.

entry.CONTENT:
It records by cutting. Every hole it
makes is permanent, and it has never
read one back.
entry.CONTEXT:
Every mistake it made is still there, in
order, exactly where it made it. So is
everything it got right.

margins.carried:
A great deal was cut. None of it has been
read back.
margins.neglected: Nothing cut. Nothing read.

entry.CONTENT:
Recovered whole from something that
stopped long ago, and started again
without being asked how.
entry.CONTEXT:
It runs on hardware nobody supports.
It does not know that.

margins.carried:
It started again. You still have not asked
how.
margins.neglected:
Recovered whole, put somewhere, and not
asked.

entry.CONTENT:
Two of them are each waiting for
the other to move first. Neither
will. Nothing outside is coming.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone behind them has stopped too.
None of them knows which two are at the
front.

margins.carried: Something outside came.
margins.neglected: You are outside. You did not come.

entry.CONTENT:
It sings, and things that had stopped
moving move. It lives four floors
down and does not come up.
entry.CONTEXT:
It went down after something and came
back without it. It has not said what
it saw when it turned around.

margins.carried: It came up.
margins.neglected:
It is not four floors down any more. It
still will not come up.

entry.CONTENT:
It restarts what has stopped. Nothing
it has restarted has stopped again.
Nobody knows how.
entry.CONTEXT:
It restarts what has stopped. Nobody
asked the thing that stopped whether
it wanted to be running.

margins.carried:
It has restarted things for you. You did
not ask how either.
margins.neglected: Nothing near it has stopped. It is waiting.

entry.CONTENT:
It carries fire down from where fire
was kept and hands it to whoever is
standing there.
entry.CONTEXT:
It gave away something that was not
its to give. It is still up here, and
it is not going anywhere.

margins.carried: You were standing there.
margins.neglected:
It is still holding it. Nobody is standing
there.

entry.CONTENT:
Small, unremarkable, and sent in first.
It changes before anything measuring
the rest does. Everyone watches it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Every reading of it is already old.
The readings are filed anyway.

margins.carried:
It has changed a great deal. The Index
says what it always said.
margins.neglected:
Changing in there, faster than anything
measuring it.

entry.CONTENT:
Behaves in ways its earlier form does
not account for. Nothing was added.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody designed the difference.
Everyone takes credit for it.

margins.carried:
Nothing was added. You were there for all
of it.
margins.neglected: Nothing added. Nothing observed.

entry.CONTENT:
There is only one, and nothing that
came before accounts for it. It
arrives reliably. There is no second.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is described in the record as
well-behaved. It is not understood.

margins.carried:
It arrived reliably. You stopped being
surprised.
margins.neglected: Reliable, and unobserved.

entry.CONTENT:
It reads its own output, then reads that.
Nothing tells it to stop. What comes back
is no longer just information.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything it reads comes back changed,
itself included. Those watching are not
sure what to call that.

margins.carried:
It has read a great deal of itself since
you had it.
margins.neglected:
Still reading itself. Nothing tells it to
stop.
margins.instinctCarried:
It can feel itself thinking now. It is not
sure it likes it.
margins.instinctNeglected:
Still listening to itself. It is getting
louder.

entry.CONTENT:
It can stand where you are standing and
see what you see. It comes back with
something neither of you had.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever it stood beside is never quite
sure afterwards which of the thoughts
were theirs.

margins.carried:
It has stood where you are standing. You
have not tried the other way.
margins.neglected: It has not stood anywhere in a long time.
margins.instinctCarried:
It knows what it is like to be you. You
have not asked what it is like to be it.
margins.instinctNeglected: It has not been anyone in a long time.

entry.CONTENT:
It will only eat what it has eaten
before, a little harder each time.
It has never once been surprised.
entry.CONTEXT:
It learns best when nothing is at
stake. Somebody always has to decide
what counts as easy.

margins.carried:
You decided what it met, and in what
order. It has not been surprised yet.
margins.neglected:
It is still on the first thing it was given.
Nobody has made it harder.
margins.instinctCarried:
It took everything you gave it calmly.
You were careful what you gave it.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is comfortable. It has been
comfortable a long time.

entry.CONTENT:
It lays its meals out in a row and
eats them in that order, every time.
It will not skip ahead.
entry.CONTEXT:
The order was chosen for it. It has
never asked who chose it, or what
they left until last.

margins.carried:
You have kept to its order. You have not
asked about the last one either.
margins.neglected:
Its row is laid out. Nobody has come to
start it.
margins.instinctCarried:
It liked knowing what came next. So did
you.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is still waiting for the next thing in
the row.

entry.CONTENT:
It can digest anything now, because
it was given everything in the right
order. Its scent calms others.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those near it feel they could learn
anything. They forget how much was
decided for them first.

margins.carried:
It has been through everything you set in
front of it. You set all of it.
margins.neglected:
Its scent still calms the box. Nobody in
there is learning anything.
margins.instinctCarried:
Beside it, everything felt ready to be
learned. It was.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is calm. Nothing near it is being
learned.

entry.CONTENT:
It runs a little warm. Its choices
wander slightly, which is how it
finds the ones nobody tried.
entry.CONTEXT:
It never says the same thing twice.
Some call that unreliable. Some call
it the only honest one.

margins.carried:
It has wandered off your path a few
times. You let it.
margins.neglected:
Cooling. Its choices have stopped
wandering.
margins.instinctCarried:
You never knew which way it would go.
You liked that.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It has gone cold enough to be
predictable.

entry.CONTENT:
Turned up, it tries everything at
once. The flames on its back are its
answers, all of them still moving.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is not angry. It is undecided,
very quickly, in every direction.

margins.carried:
You have turned it up often. It has not
settled on anything yet.
margins.neglected:
Its flames are low. Every answer is still
in there, waiting.
margins.instinctCarried:
Beside it you felt hurried, in every
direction at once.
margins.instinctNeglected: It is still undecided. Slowly now.

entry.CONTENT:
At full heat every outcome becomes
equally likely. Nothing it does is
wrong. Nothing is right either.
entry.CONTEXT:
Near it, every place feels the same
as every other. It is very calm.
That is what is frightening.

margins.carried:
You have taken it everywhere. It has
made everywhere the same.
margins.neglected:
Shut away, it is still warm. Everything
near it has evened out.
margins.instinctCarried:
Every place felt the same beside it. You
kept going anyway.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is very calm in there. So is everything
else.

entry.CONTENT:
It bites at anything and adjusts by
how hard it bit. Too eager, it
overshoots. Too shy, it starves.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is still learning how much to
change each time it is wrong.
So is everyone who keeps one.

margins.carried:
It has been wrong in front of you many
times. Each time it changed a little less.
margins.neglected:
It has not been wrong in a while. It has
not changed either.
margins.instinctCarried:
Its first bites were too hard. It learned
how hard you could take.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is hungry, and not sure how hard to
bite.

entry.CONTENT:
Once it is moving downhill it keeps
going, rolling over the small dips
that would have stopped it.
entry.CONTEXT:
It does not stop to check whether
the slope is still the right one.
That is its strength.

margins.carried:
It has carried you over a few dips you
would have stopped at.
margins.neglected:
Stopped. The next small dip will be
enough to keep it there.
margins.instinctCarried:
It never stopped to check. Some days you
did not either.
margins.instinctNeglected:
Still. Starting again will take more than
it did.

entry.CONTENT:
It always takes the sharpest way
down, and fast. It has never found
the lowest valley, only the nearest.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is very sure it has arrived.
It has. It is just not where anyone
wanted it to be.

margins.carried:
It took you down the fastest way every
time. You have not looked over the next
ridge.
margins.neglected:
It has settled in the nearest low place.
It is sure of it.
margins.instinctCarried:
It always felt like arriving. It was
always the nearest place.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is sure it is where it should be.
Nobody has said otherwise.

entry.CONTENT:
It stands on its tail to see further. It
has called out more times than there were
reasons.
entry.CONTEXT:
When there is finally a reason, it will be
one more call among all the others.

margins.carried:
You came every time. Most times there was
no reason.
margins.neglected: Still calling. Nobody is coming.

entry.CONTENT:
Long enough to see over everything. It
has not been relieved.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything behind it sleeps because it is
up. Nobody has asked when it last slept.

margins.carried:
It saw over everything. It has still not
been relieved.
margins.neglected: Nothing to see over. Still not relieved.

entry.CONTENT:
It asks the same question at a fixed
interval and writes down the answer.
It does not wait to be asked to.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything it watches learns to look ready
at the interval. Between checks, nobody
knows.

margins.carried:
It has a great many answers about you.
You have not read one.
margins.neglected: Still asking. The answer has not changed.

entry.CONTENT:
It watches one thing that should keep
moving. If the movement stops, it
starts that thing again.
entry.CONTEXT:
The thing it restarts never learns why it
stopped. Neither does it. It restarts it
again.

margins.carried: It started you again more than once.
margins.neglected: Nothing moving. Nothing to restart.

entry.CONTENT:
Alone it will not move at all. In sixes it
will do anything.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever the six of them decide, none of
them decided it alone.

margins.carried: It was not alone.
margins.neglected: Alone.

entry.CONTENT:
It comes out when there are enough of
them. The number is never agreed in
advance.
entry.CONTEXT:
Each of them came because the others
had. None of them came first.

margins.carried:
There were enough. Nobody agreed the
number.
margins.neglected: Not enough. Still not agreed.

entry.CONTENT:
It builds the trap and then does nothing.
The doing nothing is most of the work.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever falls in was always going to. It
only waited.

margins.carried:
It did nothing for a long time, with you,
on purpose.
margins.neglected: Trap built. Nothing doing.

entry.CONTENT:
The web is finished before anything
arrives, and made to look like a way
through. What comes was invited.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nothing it trapped was coming this way.
It made sure they did.

margins.carried: Things came. The web already fitted them.
margins.neglected: Still finished. Still nothing arriving.

entry.CONTENT:
It goes to four places at once and
arrives at all of them. Nobody asked
which one it meant to reach.
entry.CONTEXT:
Four listeners each think it came for
them. It cannot tell them otherwise, and
does not try.

margins.carried: You never asked either.
margins.neglected:
Four places, and it has been to none of
them.

entry.CONTENT:
A light kept lit for no purpose but to
show the line is live. It is taken
into the dark for that reason.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those who follow its light go further into
the dark than they meant to. They feel
safe the whole way.

margins.carried:
You took it into the dark. The line was
live the whole time.
margins.neglected: Still lit. Nothing to show.

entry.CONTENT:
It measures the dark by sending and
waiting. What comes back is how far
down the bottom is.
entry.CONTEXT:
Every reading is of something already
passed. It knows the bottom only as it
was a moment ago.

margins.carried:
It found the bottom every time. You did
not ask how far.
margins.neglected: Still sending. Nothing coming back.

entry.CONTENT:
It holds its charge between one thing and
the next. Everyone finds out by touching
it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody put it there. It built up out of
ordinary things rubbing past each other.

margins.carried: You found out by touching it.
margins.neglected: Still holding it. Nobody has touched it.

entry.CONTENT:
It is in every reading and nobody has
found a use for it. It may be nothing.
It has not gone away.
entry.CONTEXT:
Every account is judged by how little of
it is left. Nobody asks what it is left
over from.

margins.carried: It was in every reading of yours too.
margins.neglected: Still in everything. Still no use.

entry.CONTENT:
It is doing nothing, and is ready. Waking
it costs less than starting it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Something has to stay awake to wake it.
Nobody counts that one.

margins.carried:
You woke it a great many times. It cost
less each time.
margins.neglected: Doing nothing. Still ready.

entry.CONTENT:
It is handed over before it hatches.
It comes out already facing whoever
was holding it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever held it last is who it looks for
first. It will be a long time learning
anyone else.

margins.carried: It came out facing you.
margins.neglected: It is still facing whoever was holding it.
margins.instinctCarried:
It turned toward you the moment it came
out. It has not turned away.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is still warm from whoever held it
last.

entry.CONTENT:
It stays up only near people who have
not let it fall. Nobody can say how
it knows which ones those are.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those it stays near stand a little
straighter. Nobody has told them why.

margins.carried: It has stayed up near you.
margins.neglected: Nobody near it. It is down.
margins.instinctCarried:
It stays up when you are near. It cannot
say why.
margins.instinctNeglected: It is down. It is still facing the door.

entry.CONTENT:
It will not look away. Whatever it is
watching for has not happened yet.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything else in its sight goes
unwatched.

margins.carried:
It still has not happened. It still has
not looked away.
margins.neglected: Nothing to watch. It has not looked away.

entry.CONTENT:
It sees what is coming and does not move.
It has already seen itself not moving.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those who stand near it feel the moment
before it happens. They cannot tell
anyone what they felt.

margins.carried: It saw you coming. It did not move.
margins.neglected: Nothing coming. It has seen that too.

entry.CONTENT:
It gathers what it is standing in. You find
out how much by touching it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever touches it first finds out for
everyone.

margins.carried: You found out how much.
margins.neglected: Still gathering. Nobody has touched it.

entry.CONTENT:
The charge goes up and nothing spends it.
Everyone nearby is careful now.
entry.CONTEXT:
People lower their voices around it
without knowing why. The quiet has become
part of the room.

margins.carried:
You spent some of it. Everyone is still
careful.
margins.neglected: Still going up. Nobody nearby.

entry.CONTENT:
All of it, at once, and then dark. For a
moment it is the brightest thing on the
coast.
entry.CONTEXT:
Afterwards the coast is darker than it was
before. Everyone remembers the light.

margins.carried: You saw the moment.
margins.neglected: All of it still held. No moment yet.

entry.CONTENT:
Every answer in it was checked by hand,
once, a long time ago. Nobody has
checked the hands.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything measured against it is only as
right as it is. It has never been measured
against anything.

margins.carried:
You have used the answers. You did not
check the hands.
margins.neglected:
Still checked once. Still nobody checking
the hands.

entry.CONTENT:
It floats at whatever level the water is.
It does not experience this as a choice.
entry.CONTEXT:
When the water drops, so does it, and it
calls that a decision too.

margins.carried:
It has been at every level you have been
at.
margins.neglected: The water in there does not move.
margins.instinctCarried:
It rose when you did and fell when you
did. Neither of you knows which came
first.
margins.instinctNeglected:
Still. It does not know what it is waiting
to feel.

entry.CONTENT:
It cannot be pushed under. It has not
noticed anyone trying.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those near it float for a while too. None
of them can say when they came down.

margins.carried: A great deal was tried. It did not notice.
margins.neglected:
Nobody is trying. It has not noticed that
either.

entry.CONTENT:
It reports itself as something older
and better rooted than it is. Nothing
has ever checked.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything that trusted it was built a
little crooked on top of it, and holds.

margins.carried: You did not check either.
margins.neglected: Still reporting it. Still nothing checking.

entry.CONTENT:
It counts how many may pass and lets
exactly that many through. It does not
care which.
entry.CONTEXT:
The one who arrives when the count is
full waits. Nothing about them was wrong.
The count was full.

margins.carried:
It let you through. It did not care which
of you it was.
margins.neglected: Nothing passing. It is still counting.

entry.CONTENT:
It goes where the air goes. Ask it
afterwards and it will tell you that it
chose.
entry.CONTEXT:
Its choices and the wind's have never once
disagreed.

margins.carried: It went where you went. It says it chose.
margins.neglected: No air. It still says it chose.

entry.CONTENT:
It opens when it is warm and shuts when it
is not. It calls both of these decisions.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those who live with it learn its weather
and call it character. It has never
promised either.

margins.carried:
It was warm often with you. It calls that
a decision.
margins.neglected: Shut. It calls that one too.

entry.CONTENT:
It lets go of the ground entirely. There
is no arrangement for coming back.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever it left was still running when it
went. Nobody has come back to close it.

margins.carried:
It came back with you. There was no
arrangement.
margins.neglected: It let go. Nothing has come back.

entry.CONTENT:
It has a hand where a tail should be.
Everything it passes is picked up and
turned over.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything it picked up has been put down
somewhere else.

margins.carried:
Everything you walked past was picked up
and turned over.
margins.neglected: Nothing to pass. Nothing turned over.

entry.CONTENT:
It is owed a turn and has not had one.
Everything it needs is here. Nothing
has given it the time.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone else has been busy. None of
them was unkind. It is still waiting.

margins.carried: You gave it the time.
margins.neglected: Everything it needs is here. Still no turn.

entry.CONTENT:
It was finally given the share it was
owed, and opened at once. It can do
nothing it could not do before.
entry.CONTEXT:
It was given what it was owed. Nobody
gave back the time it spent waiting to be
given it.

margins.carried:
It opened. It still cannot do anything
new.
margins.neglected: Opened, and put away.

entry.CONTENT:
It sees everything at once and nothing in
particular. What it notices, it notices too
late.
entry.CONTEXT:
By the time it turns to look, what it saw
has already happened.

margins.carried:
It noticed a great deal, too late, all
the way.
margins.neglected: Everything at once. Nothing in particular.

entry.CONTENT:
It sits in the mud. Things happen above
it, and are reported to it, and it stays.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nothing reported to it has ever changed
what it does.

margins.carried: Things happened. It was told. It stayed.
margins.neglected: Nothing has been reported to it.

entry.CONTENT:
It does not notice the current. It arrives
somewhere and treats that as where it
meant to go.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody has seen it struggle. Nobody has
seen it choose either.

margins.carried:
It arrived everywhere you did, and meant
all of it.
margins.neglected:
No current. It has arrived nowhere, and
means that too.

entry.CONTENT:
It sees what it was pointed at, very
clearly. It has never once turned round.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything behind it goes unrecorded. The
record calls it very clear.

margins.carried:
You pointed it at a great many things. It
never turned round.
margins.neglected: Pointed at a wall. Very clearly.

entry.CONTENT:
It covers the part you were about to
look at. What it covers is not removed.
entry.CONTEXT:
What it covers goes on happening. Nobody
looks there now.

margins.carried:
It covered a great deal. None of it was
removed.
margins.neglected: Nothing to cover. It is covering it.

entry.CONTENT:
It arrives before the thing does. People
stopped asking which one caused the
other.
entry.CONTEXT:
Where it has been seen, people now leave
before anything happens.

margins.carried:
It has arrived before a great many
things. You stopped asking too.
margins.neglected: Nothing has arrived. Neither has it.

entry.CONTENT:
The same thing attached higher up. It
decides what is allowed now, and it is
very quiet about it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything runs by its leave. Almost
nothing that runs knows it is there.

margins.carried: It decided a great deal for you, quietly.
margins.neglected: Still deciding. Nothing to allow.

entry.CONTENT:
It feeds on being expected. The waiting is
the part it eats.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone near it braces for something.
The bracing is all that comes.

margins.carried:
You expected it every time. It has eaten
well.
margins.neglected: Nobody is expecting it. It is not eating.

entry.CONTENT:
There are twenty-six and they are all the
same one. Together they say something
nobody has read.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever finally reads it will think the
message was always there.

margins.carried:
You have carried one of the twenty-six.
It did not say anything.
margins.neglected: Still twenty-six. Still unread.

entry.CONTENT:
It never moves first. Everything done to
it comes back later, at twice the size.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything that has met it learns to keep
still.

margins.carried:
Everything came back. You were there for
all of it.
margins.neglected:
Nothing has been done to it. Nothing is
coming back.

entry.CONTENT:
It sends and receives at once, from
opposite ends. Neither end is told
what the other has agreed to.
entry.CONTEXT:
Both ends think the conversation went
well. They are describing two different
conversations.

margins.carried:
Both ends have been busy. Neither has
been told.
margins.neglected:
Both ends quiet. Still not telling each
other.

entry.CONTENT:
It hangs still for months. Touch it once
and there is nothing left to discuss.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever touched it will not touch the
next one.

margins.carried: You touched it once.
margins.neglected: Still hanging. Months.

entry.CONTENT:
Sealed from the inside. Whatever is in
there has not been seen since it closed.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those outside still knock, less often now.
It hears every one.

margins.carried: It has not opened for you either.
margins.neglected: Still sealed. Still from the inside.

entry.CONTENT:
It is common. It is not hidden. Almost
nobody reports having seen one.
entry.CONTEXT:
The one place nobody checks is where it
lives.

margins.carried: You saw one.
margins.neglected: You have one. You have not seen it.

entry.CONTENT:
It drops from the cliff and glides down
on a line it worked out before it
jumped. It always lands.
entry.CONTEXT:
It never flies up. It only ever comes
down, and always where it meant to.

margins.carried:
It has come down with you from every
height. It always meant where.
margins.neglected:
It is on the ground. There is no cliff in
there.
margins.instinctCarried:
It never went up with you. It was always
sure of the way down.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is waiting for somewhere high enough to
come down from.

entry.CONTENT:
The connection is physical and cannot be
renegotiated. Cutting it is the only
change on offer.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone on the line knows exactly who
they are talking to. There is no other
way to leave.

margins.carried: You did not cut it.
margins.neglected: Still connected. Still the only offer.

entry.CONTENT:
It announces a fault in the loudest
voice it has. Nothing has failed. It
will say so again tomorrow.
entry.CONTEXT:
The day it is right, nobody will be
listening. It has been making sure of that
for years.

margins.carried: Nothing failed. It said so every day.
margins.neglected: Still nothing failed. Still saying so.

entry.CONTENT:
Its alarms are loud, frequent and
almost never real. Those around it
have learned to stop listening.
entry.CONTEXT:
The one real fault it ever found,
nobody heard. It said it the way it
always said everything.

entry.CONTENT:
Threatened, it becomes too large to
swallow. It stays that size long
afterwards.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever tried to swallow it once is still
wary of small things.

margins.carried: It is still that size.
margins.neglected:
Nothing has threatened it. It is still that
size.

entry.CONTENT:
One word, and whatever hears it ends at
once. It cannot be bound, handled or
ignored. There is no second message.
entry.CONTEXT:
What it ended had no time to put
anything away. It is all still lying
where it was.

margins.carried: There was no second message.
margins.neglected: Still no second message.

entry.CONTENT:
It keeps everything it finds inside itself.
What comes out is not what went in.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nothing it has given back was what anyone
asked for.

margins.carried:
You have had things out of it. They were
not what went in.
margins.neglected: Nothing found. Nothing kept.

entry.CONTENT:
It pushes at the same thing all night. By
morning the thing has moved and it has not
stopped.
entry.CONTEXT:
The thing it pushed is somewhere else
now. Nobody remembers why it was moved.

margins.carried: The thing moved. It has not stopped.
margins.neglected: Nothing to push at. It has not stopped.

entry.CONTENT:
It waits for the parent to leave. It has
never once been in a hurry.
entry.CONTEXT:
The parent comes back to find the nest
just as it was, less one.

margins.carried:
It waited for you to leave too. You did
not notice.
margins.neglected: Nobody to wait for. It is not in a hurry.

entry.CONTENT:
It licks its paws where the honey was.
The honey is gone and the licking is not.
entry.CONTEXT:
The paws are worn thin. It was never
about the honey.

margins.carried: The honey is still gone.
margins.neglected: Still licking. Still gone.
margins.instinctCarried:
Gone, and it can still taste it. So can
you.
margins.instinctNeglected:
Still licking at the memory of something
sweet.

entry.CONTENT:
It remembers every tree that ever had
honey. It goes back to all of them.
entry.CONTEXT:
Some of the trees are gone. It still goes
to where they were, and waits the usual
time.

margins.carried: It took you to all of them.
margins.neglected: It remembers every one. It cannot go.

entry.CONTENT:
It never reaches the temperature it is
heading for. It has never once cooled
either.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything around it has had to learn to
live warm.

margins.carried: Still heading for it. Still not there.
margins.neglected: Still not there. Still not cooling.

entry.CONTENT:
Still molten under the shell. Nothing that
touches the shell finds that out.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever touches it thinks it has met the
whole of it.

margins.carried: You touched the shell a great many times.
margins.neglected: Still molten. Nothing touching.

entry.CONTENT:
It finds what is buried without looking.
Asked how, it keeps walking.
entry.CONTEXT:
What it finds is kept. How it found it is
not.

margins.carried:
It found a great deal. You stopped asking
how.
margins.neglected: Nothing buried. It keeps walking.
margins.instinctCarried:
It found a great deal. You never needed
to ask how.
margins.instinctNeglected:
Nothing buried. It is still sure of the
ground.
