entry.CONTENT:
It cannot see past its own hair. It
charges anyway, and is usually right.
entry.CONTEXT:
The ones who follow it get there first.
They do not always know where there was.

margins.carried:
It charged a great many times. It was
usually right.
margins.neglected: Nothing to charge at. It still cannot see.

entry.CONTENT:
It grows on its own, away from the
rest of the reef. Break a branch off
and it simply grows another.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody joined it back to the main
reef. It kept growing anyway, and
now nobody knows how.

margins.carried:
It has grown a great deal with you.
Nobody has joined it back to anything.
margins.neglected:
It is still growing in there, on its own.
Nobody is watching how.
margins.instinctCarried:
It broke a few times along the way. It
grew back each time.
margins.instinctNeglected: Away from everything, still branching.

entry.CONTENT:
It fastens to something larger and
travels. It has never chosen the
direction.
entry.CONTEXT:
Wherever the larger thing goes, it
arrives, and is counted as having
travelled.

margins.carried:
It fastened to you. It still did not
choose.
margins.neglected: Nothing larger. Nowhere.
margins.instinctCarried:
It feels safe beside you. It does not
know you.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is holding on to nothing, and it still
feels held.

entry.CONTENT:
It holds on with everything it has. It
does this to rocks as well.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whatever it holds cannot move far. It
calls that being close.

margins.carried:
It held on to you. It does that to rocks
as well.
margins.neglected: Nothing to hold on to. It is holding on.

entry.CONTENT:
It brings something to whoever fed it. The
amounts have never matched and it keeps
coming.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever fed it stopped counting long ago.
It has not stopped counting.

margins.carried:
The amounts still do not match. It is
still coming.
margins.neglected:
Nobody has fed it. It has nothing to
bring.

entry.CONTENT:
Whatever is put on it, it rises anyway.
Nobody has found the weight that settles
it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything piled on it is carried up as
well, whether or not it wanted to be.

margins.carried:
You put a great deal on it. It rose
anyway.
margins.neglected: Nothing on it. Still rising.

entry.CONTENT:
Every edge of it is a defence. It cannot
be held, and it cannot hold.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything that has ever tried to help it
has come away cut.

margins.carried: You carried it anyway.
margins.neglected: Nothing held. Nothing holding.

entry.CONTENT:
It picks one and follows only that one.
The others walk past it unharmed.
entry.CONTEXT:
The others have learned they can walk
right past it.

margins.carried: It picked you.
margins.neglected: It has not picked anything.

entry.CONTENT:
Everyone who has heard its cry remembers
it. It has only ever had the one.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those who heard it begin to hear it
everywhere. The cry did not follow them.
They brought it.

margins.carried: You remember it.
margins.neglected: Still the one cry. Nobody has heard it.

entry.CONTENT:
Small errors upstream arrive here as
large ones. Nothing was wrong when it
left.
entry.CONTEXT:
Downstream they blame the storm. Upstream
they remember a very small thing, and say
nothing.

margins.carried: Nothing was wrong when it left you either.
margins.neglected: Nothing upstream. Nothing arriving.

entry.CONTENT:
Small, and it keeps everything. It will
bring back something from a year ago,
exactly.
entry.CONTEXT:
It brings back things everyone else had
agreed to forget.

margins.carried: It has a year of you, exactly.
margins.neglected:
It is keeping everything. Nothing has
happened.

entry.CONTENT:
What went in is still in, in the shape it
went in. Nothing has worn smooth.
entry.CONTEXT:
Every new thing is held up against it to
see whether it fits. Most of them are
made to.

margins.carried:
Everything you did is in there, in the
shape it went in.
margins.neglected: Nothing went in. Nothing has worn smooth.

entry.CONTENT:
A second layer laid over the first to
correct it. The first is still underneath,
still wrong.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone reads the correction. Under it,
the first one goes on doing what it always
did.

margins.carried:
You have only ever read the second
layer.
margins.neglected: Both layers. Neither read.

entry.CONTENT:
Look at its antlers and the ground tilts.
The ground has not tilted.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those who looked walk differently for a
while afterwards.

margins.carried:
The ground did not tilt. You leaned
anyway.
margins.neglected: Nobody is looking at its antlers.

entry.CONTENT:
It does whatever it last saw done. Nobody
has seen it do a thing of its own.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever it watched last is now doing
everything twice.

margins.carried:
It has done everything you have done.
Nobody has seen it do one of its own.
margins.neglected: It has not seen anything done.

entry.CONTENT:
Everything after it rests on it. It is the
part nobody checks.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything built on it is very sound. That
is not the same as true.

margins.carried: You did not check it either.
margins.neglected: Nothing rests on it. Still unchecked.

entry.CONTENT:
It arrives back where it started and calls
that the finish. It is always very fast.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever follows it arrives where they
started, faster than ever, and calls it
progress.

margins.carried:
It finished a great many times. You went
somewhere.
margins.neglected: Back where it started. Very fast.

entry.CONTENT:
It gives away what it is about to do. It
does not know that it is doing this.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone who plays it has read it. It
wonders how they always know.

margins.carried:
You read it every time. It still does not
know.
margins.neglected:
Nothing to give away. It is giving it
away.

entry.CONTENT:
It has to be turned by hand before it
will do anything. Afterwards it will not
stop.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever turned it is long gone. It is still
running on that one turn.

margins.carried: You turned it. It has not stopped.
margins.neglected: Nobody has turned it.

entry.CONTENT:
What is left once the work is finished. It
is still warm, and it is still a hazard.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody remembers what burned. They still
step round it.

margins.carried:
The work finished a long time ago. It is
still warm.
margins.neglected: Still warm. Still a hazard. In a box.

entry.CONTENT:
It holds what everything nearby will
want next and gives it up at once.
Asking it costs less than working.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone nearby has forgotten how to do
the work themselves. It has never once
been asked to.

margins.carried: It had what you wanted next, every time.
margins.neglected: Nothing nearby wants anything.

entry.CONTENT:
It reports that it is alive at a fixed
interval. Nothing else it says is listened
to.
entry.CONTEXT:
As long as the interval keeps coming,
nobody asks how it is.

margins.carried:
You listened to the interval and nothing
else.
margins.neglected:
Still reporting. Nothing listening at all
now.

entry.CONTENT:
It arrives just after the light, with a
crack that shakes the windows. You
always see it before you hear it.
entry.CONTEXT:
By the time it is heard, whatever it
was announcing has already happened.

margins.carried:
You stopped waiting for the crack. You
knew from the light.
margins.neglected: No light, so no thunder.
margins.instinctCarried:
Your heart jumped every time. It never
stopped jumping.
margins.instinctNeglected: It is the quiet after something.

entry.CONTENT:
It sleeps under the mountain and keeps
burning. Every so often the ground
remembers it is there.
entry.CONTEXT:
Covering it over did not put it out.
Nothing ever has.

margins.carried:
You have carried it everywhere. It has
not gone out.
margins.neglected: Put away, and still burning.
margins.instinctCarried:
It was always warmer near it than you
expected.
margins.instinctNeglected:
Somewhere under everything, it is still
burning.

entry.CONTENT:
It runs across water without breaking
the surface, and whatever it passes
over is left clear.
entry.CONTEXT:
PHOENIX started it again once. It
has been clearing things ever since.

margins.carried:
Everywhere you have taken it is a little
clearer.
margins.neglected:
It is standing on still water. Nothing is
being cleared.
margins.instinctCarried:
You felt clearer after it passed. You
could not have said why.
margins.instinctNeglected: The surface it rests on has not broken.

entry.CONTENT:
It eats a mountain to get out of the
mountain. It is still eating.
entry.CONTEXT:
The mountain has been getting smaller for
years. It has not got out.

margins.carried: It is out. It is still eating.
margins.neglected: Still eating. Still in.

entry.CONTENT:
Sealed in, it turns one dark thing over
and over. Inside, it moves at speed.
There is no way to ask where to.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody near it is told what it is
thinking about. They feel the weight
of it anyway.

margins.carried:
It went where you went. You still could
not ask.
margins.neglected: Still sealed. Still moving. Nowhere.

entry.CONTENT:
It brings the mountain down and stands in
it. It has been owed something since it
was small.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone who remembers what it was owed
has moved away. It has not.

margins.carried:
It is still owed it. You were not the one
who owed it.
margins.neglected: Still owed. Still standing in it.

entry.CONTENT:
Three of them quarrelled until it
arrived. It took no side and said
nothing. They have not quarrelled since.
entry.CONTEXT:
The peace it keeps is real. None of the
three could tell you what it cost,
because it never said.

margins.carried: It has said nothing to you either.
margins.neglected: Nothing quarrelling. Nothing to settle.

entry.CONTENT:
It is the only one that can start
itself. What it leaves behind is what
it starts from.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything it burns becomes the start of
it. Whatever was there before is not
coming back.

margins.carried:
It has started itself since you had it.
You did nothing.
margins.neglected: It has not needed to start.

entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody has caught it twice. It does
not come back for the same person.

margins.carried: You reached at the right moment.
margins.neglected:
You reached in time. Then you put it
away.
margins.instinctCarried:
You felt the moment before it came. You
were ready.
margins.instinctNeglected:
The moment it was there for has passed.
It stayed anyway.

entry.CONTENT:
No record of this daemon was ever
written. What you are reading was
assembled from the entries either side.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is not rare. It is uncounted.
The list that would hold it stops one
short, and nobody has ever noticed.

entry.CONTENT:
It brings a painted mirror in its mouth to
anyone lost in the night. Blank canvases
come in many forms, it seems to say.
entry.CONTEXT:
The mirror reflects what its holder needs
to learn. Held long enough, it is also a
window into other worlds.

margins.carried:
You have looked into the mirror it
carries. You looked for a long time.
margins.neglected:
It is still holding the mirror out. Nobody
has taken it.

entry.CONTENT:
A familiar glow in the dark. In its light,
fears calm, and the shapes that
frightened you are seen to be friends.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those who once saw its light walk their
own path after, sure of their footing even
at night.

margins.carried:
You have walked a long way by its light.
You have not once looked lost.
margins.neglected:
It is still shining where it was left.
Somebody, somewhere, is walking toward it.

entry.CONTENT:
It passes close only once in a long while.
In that pass it teaches the lesson that
stays: being different is good.
entry.CONTEXT:
Its pupils hardly saw it go. Long after,
they still hear what it taught them, now
in their own voices.

margins.carried:
It has stayed close to you a long while
now. That is not like it.
margins.neglected: It has gone round again. It will be back.

entry.CONTENT:
It sees others before they are willing to
see themselves. It crosses great distances
to visit, and asks nothing for the fare.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those it saw rarely see it in time. After,
they mean more to it than they can ever
express, and cannot say so.

margins.carried: You saw it in time.
margins.neglected: It came all this way. You put it away.

entry.CONTENT:
A shadow in the shapes of many animals:
those someone tried to heal, but could
not reach. A small light stays lit within.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those who walked away for their own
well-being meet it again in the dark. Once
they accept it, its shadow fades.

margins.carried: You did not walk away from this one.
margins.neglected:
You walked away. It understands. Its
light is still on.

entry.CONTENT:
The light within it grew until it was all
there was. It was always a friend. It was
only that the night was dark.
entry.CONTEXT:
Near it, the ones who were afraid feel
the strength of reconnection, and are no
longer afraid.

margins.carried: You stayed until it was all light.
margins.neglected: Even put away, it is not dark in there.

entry.CONTENT:
A small cat that seems somehow familiar.
Its tufted ears hear what most cannot,
and it never forgets a visitor.
entry.CONTEXT:
When a guest leaves, it waits by the
door. It knows before they do who will be
missed.

margins.carried: It follows you from room to room now.
margins.neglected: It is waiting by the door.

entry.CONTENT:
It sits as still as a temple statue. Those
it watches begin to reach for more, and
make things beyond their day's work.
entry.CONTEXT:
Its keepers learn that their only limits
were ever the ones they imagined.

margins.carried:
You have made more since you started
carrying it.
margins.neglected:
It is sitting very still. It is waiting for
you to begin.

entry.CONTENT:
It can ask only one question: above
or below? It is right a little more
often than a guess would be.
entry.CONTEXT:
Alone it is barely better than
chance. Nobody has told it yet that
alone is not how it will be used.

margins.carried:
You keep asking it. It keeps being a
little right.
margins.neglected: Alone, and asking nobody.
margins.instinctCarried:
You leaned on it more than its one
question deserved. It held.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is still asking above or below. Nobody
needs the answer.

entry.CONTENT:
It studies its own mistakes and
sends the next one in to fix them.
Its leaves grow where it was wrong.
entry.CONTEXT:
Each one that follows is shaped by
the last one's failures. None of
them is ever told it was enough.

margins.carried:
Its leaves are thick now. You know where
each one grew.
margins.neglected:
No new leaves. Nothing has been wrong
near it.
margins.instinctCarried:
It kept fixing what the last one missed.
You never had to ask.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is still waiting to be told it was
enough.

entry.CONTENT:
Hundreds of small questions, added
up, make one answer that is hard to
fool. It guards the whole wood.
entry.CONTEXT:
No tree in it knows what the forest
decided. It decided anyway.

margins.carried:
You have trusted its answer more than any
one of its trees.
margins.neglected:
The wood is still deciding things. Nobody
comes to ask.
margins.instinctCarried:
It always seemed to know. No part of it
did.
margins.instinctNeglected: Quiet in there, the way a wood is quiet.

entry.CONTENT:
It decides by chance and says so.
Half the time it is right. It never
pretends to know which half.
entry.CONTEXT:
People trust it more than they
trust anyone who claims to be sure.

margins.carried:
You have followed it either way. It has
not pretended once.
margins.neglected:
Nothing to decide. It is still not
pretending.
margins.instinctCarried: You trusted it more than the sure ones.
margins.instinctNeglected:
Heads or tails. Nobody has asked it to
land.

entry.CONTENT:
It guesses a thousand times and
counts what it found. The answer is
almost always close. Almost.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is quick and usually right, and
it cannot tell you when it is not.

margins.carried:
It has been close every time you asked.
You have not checked how close.
margins.neglected:
No guesses. It is not even close to
anything.
margins.instinctCarried:
It was always nearly right. Nearly felt
like enough.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is still counting something nobody
asked about.

entry.CONTENT:
It rolls the dice until the answer
is proven, then stops. It is never
wrong. It is sometimes very late.
entry.CONTEXT:
Ask it something and wait. It will
not hand you a guess dressed as an
answer. Some cannot bear the wait.

margins.carried:
You have waited for it every time. It has
not been wrong yet.
margins.neglected:
It is still rolling for something. Nobody
is waiting on the answer.
margins.instinctCarried:
Waiting on it was hard. Being sure was
worth it, most days.
margins.instinctNeglected: Somewhere in there, it is still rolling.

entry.CONTENT:
Water finds its way off it, always
downhill, carrying a little of the
ground with it each time.
entry.CONTEXT:
It does not notice what it takes.
The hillside does.

margins.carried:
It has run down every hill you took it
over. They are all a little lower.
margins.neglected:
No rain. It has taken nothing from anyone
in a while.
margins.instinctCarried:
Everywhere it went, it took a little with
it. You did not notice either.
margins.instinctNeglected:
Dry. The hillside has stopped losing
anything.

entry.CONTENT:
What the water carried, it lays
down in layers. Every flood it has
seen is in it, oldest at the bottom.
entry.CONTEXT:
Dig into it and you find every
change it was ever made to make,
in order.

margins.carried:
There is a layer for each of your fights
now, the first one deepest.
margins.neglected:
Nothing new has settled on it since you
put it down.
margins.instinctCarried:
Dig into it and you would find yourself,
in order.
margins.instinctNeglected: Its top layer is the day you left it.

entry.CONTENT:
Where it meets the sea it spreads
into a hundred small corrections,
each one the size of its last miss.
entry.CONTEXT:
It moves by the difference between
where it is and where it was told
to be. It never arrives. It gets close.

margins.carried:
It is closer to where you wanted it than
it has ever been. It has not arrived.
margins.neglected:
Nobody is telling it where to be. It has
stopped correcting.
margins.instinctCarried:
It never arrived anywhere with you. It
was always close.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is still spreading toward somewhere it
was once told to go.

entry.CONTENT:
It rubs up against anything it passes
and leaves it a little harder to read.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody notices one smudge. A pack of
them can blur a whole town.

margins.carried:
Everything you have walked it past is a
little harder to read now.
margins.neglected: Nothing has been smudged in a while.
margins.instinctCarried:
Things got a little blurrier with it
around. You did not mind.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is rubbing against the walls of the
box.

entry.CONTENT:
When it stands in front of something,
nothing behind it can be seen at all.
It hunts by that.
entry.CONTEXT:
You can see its shape perfectly. That
is all you will ever see of it.

margins.carried:
You know its shape very well by now. That
is all you know.
margins.neglected: Nothing is standing behind it.
margins.instinctCarried:
You never saw past it. You stopped
trying.
margins.instinctNeglected:
In the dark it is only a shape. It was
only a shape before.

entry.CONTENT:
It never goes straight anywhere. It
runs off on every path it finds and
somehow comes back with something.
entry.CONTEXT:
Follow its tracks and you will be lost
long before it is.

margins.carried:
It has taken you off every path you were
on. You came back with something each
time.
margins.neglected:
It is not wandering. It has nothing to
bring back.
margins.instinctCarried:
You were lost with it more than once. It
never was.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is sniffing at the corners, looking for
a path.

entry.CONTENT:
It runs in perfectly straight lines and
never turns aside. Everything it needs
it carries with it.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is very fast, because it never
stops to ask where to go next.

margins.carried:
It has run straight ahead every time you
let it. You have let it more and more.
margins.neglected:
It has stopped. It does not know how to
turn.
margins.instinctCarried:
It never asked where you were going. It
just went.
margins.instinctNeglected: Still pointed straight ahead, at the wall.

entry.CONTENT:
A number nobody chose decides what it
will grow into. Even it does not know
which.
entry.CONTEXT:
Two that look the same will not end the
same. Nobody can tell which from outside.

entry.CONTENT:
Sealed in pale silk. Inside, the condition
held. It will come out as what follows.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is sure it is on the right path. It has
only seen the one.

entry.CONTENT:
What follows a condition that held. It is
bright, and flies the path that was
expected.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone was hoping for this one. It
never learned why.

entry.CONTENT:
Sealed in dark silk. Inside, the condition
failed. It goes on anyway, the other way.
entry.CONTEXT:
It does not know it is the other case. To
it, this is the case.

entry.CONTENT:
What follows a condition that failed. It
flies at night, by a path nobody wrote
down.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody planned for it. It got there
anyway, and lights its own way.

entry.CONTENT:
It drifts on the water and takes one
small step each time the current
pulses. It never hurries.
entry.CONTEXT:
It keeps to a rhythm nobody set.
It would be lost without one.

margins.carried:
It kept to its step the whole way. You
learned to wait for it.
margins.neglected:
No current. It has not taken a step in a
long time.
margins.instinctCarried:
You walked a little slower with it. It
never asked you to.
margins.instinctNeglected: It is still keeping time to something.

entry.CONTENT:
Its steps start large and shrink as
it nears what it wants, then grow
again to look somewhere new.
entry.CONTEXT:
It slows down when it is close. Most
things speed up. It has learned
better.

margins.carried:
It slowed down every time it was close.
You started to notice when it was close.
margins.neglected:
Its steps have stopped. It was nowhere
near anything.
margins.instinctCarried:
It always slowed before you knew you
were close.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is between steps, and not sure how big
the next should be.

entry.CONTENT:
It dances in rising and falling
waves, and every turn of the dance
settles it somewhere a little better.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those who hear its rhythm start to
move with it. Nobody remembers
deciding to.

margins.carried:
You have been moving with it for some
time. You did not decide to.
margins.neglected:
The dance has stopped. It settled where
it was.
margins.instinctCarried:
You caught yourself keeping time to it
more than once.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is still swaying a little, to something
nobody else can hear.

entry.CONTENT:
It hangs from a branch and practises
the same small things, slowly at first,
then a little faster every day.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is not learning much yet. It is
learning how to learn.

margins.carried:
It has practised the same small things
with you every day. It is quicker at them
now.
margins.neglected:
It has stopped practising. Nothing is
getting quicker.
margins.instinctCarried:
It was slow at first. You were patient. It
noticed.
margins.instinctNeglected: It is hanging from something, very still.

entry.CONTENT:
It does whatever earned it something
last time, and a little more. It has
learned to look for the REWARD.
entry.CONTEXT:
Pay it for the wrong thing once and
it will find every way to earn it.

margins.carried:
It has learned what you pay for. It does
a little more of it each time.
margins.neglected:
Nothing is being paid for. It is still
looking.
margins.instinctCarried:
It always seemed to know what would
please you, before you knew you had
shown it.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is waiting for something to be worth
doing.

entry.CONTENT:
Given a REWARD, it settled on one way
of doing things. It does it the same
way in every wind.
entry.CONTEXT:
Ask it why and it cannot tell you.
It only knows what has paid.

margins.carried:
It does things your way now. It could not
tell you why.
margins.neglected:
It has kept its one way, with nothing to
do it to.
margins.instinctCarried:
It settled into your ways quickly. You did
not know you had any.
margins.instinctNeglected:
Same way, every wind. There is no wind in
there.

entry.CONTENT:
It makes copies of itself before they are
needed, and waits underground with them.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is ready for a crowd that has not
come. It does not mind waiting.

entry.CONTENT:
It does everything at once, as fast as it
can, and then it is spent. Gone before you
see it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything near it happens too fast to
watch. Then nothing happens.

entry.CONTENT:
The shell left behind when the copy
moved on. It still runs. Nothing is inside
it.
entry.CONTEXT:
It keeps its place in the list. Nobody has
cleared it. Most things pass right through
it.

entry.CONTENT:
It darts from one place to the next
one close by, never further than it
can see.
entry.CONTEXT:
It always lands exactly where it
aimed. It just never aims far.

margins.carried: You have gone a long way in short hops.
margins.neglected:
It is perched. The next place is out of
sight.
margins.instinctCarried:
Every hop with it felt safe. They were
all small.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It can see nothing near enough to land
on.

entry.CONTENT:
It leaves without warning and lands on
the far side of the world, then comes
back to the same spot it left.
entry.CONTEXT:
Wherever it goes, it remembers the
way home. That is the whole trick.

margins.carried:
It has gone a long way with you. It still
knows where you started.
margins.neglected:
It is home. It is waiting to be somewhere
else.
margins.instinctCarried:
Wherever it took you, you never felt far
from home.
margins.instinctNeglected: It is still facing the way home.

entry.CONTENT:
It boxes with anything that will
stand still, and gets a little better
every round it loses.
entry.CONTEXT:
It does not mind losing. Every
loss is something it keeps.

margins.carried:
It has lost in front of you more than
once. It kept every one.
margins.neglected:
Nothing to box. It is not losing, or
getting better.
margins.instinctCarried:
It never minded losing with you. You
minded less, after a while.
margins.instinctNeglected: It is shadowboxing in the dark.

entry.CONTENT:
Every punch leaves you one fewer
place to stand. A few moves later,
there are none.
entry.CONTEXT:
By the time you see how it will end,
it has already ended.

margins.carried:
You have stopped watching how its fights
end. You already know.
margins.neglected:
Nowhere left to stand in there. Nothing is
standing.
margins.instinctCarried:
You always knew how it would end, a
little before it did.
margins.instinctNeglected:
Still. It has already worked out how this
ends.

entry.CONTENT:
Its spots are worked out from
everything it is. Change it at all and
the spots come out completely different.
entry.CONTEXT:
No two have ever had the same spots.
That is how they tell each other apart.

margins.carried:
You could pick it out of any crowd now,
by its spots alone.
margins.neglected:
Its spots are exactly as they were. So is
everything else.
margins.instinctCarried:
You knew it by its spots from the first
day.
margins.instinctNeglected: Nobody is looking at its spots.

entry.CONTENT:
It flies the way the slope points
from wherever it happens to be. It
never looks further than that.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is right about here. It has no
idea about anywhere else, and it
flies there anyway.

margins.carried:
It took you wherever the ground tipped.
You did not look further either.
margins.neglected:
Nothing slopes in there. It does not know
which way to go.
margins.instinctCarried:
It always seemed to know the way. Only
ever the next bit of it.
margins.instinctNeglected: It is facing whichever way it last tipped.

entry.CONTENT:
Its bill holds every direction at
once, one for each way it could be
pushed. It delivers all of them.
entry.CONTEXT:
Ask it which way to go and it hands
you everything it is carrying.
Choosing is still your job.

margins.carried:
It has handed you every way there was.
You have chosen each time.
margins.neglected: Its bill is still full. Nobody is choosing.
margins.instinctCarried:
It always brought too much. You never
minded choosing.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is holding every direction, and going
none of them.

entry.CONTENT:
Hundreds skate the pond at once,
each pulled toward its own best spot
and toward the best that any found.
entry.CONTEXT:
None of them knows where the best
place is. Together they find it.

margins.carried:
You have carried one. It has been looking
for the others the whole time.
margins.neglected:
Alone in there, it is still pulled toward
the best spot it ever found.
margins.instinctCarried:
It never knew the best place. With you it
did not seem to need to.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is skating in circles, waiting for the
rest.

entry.CONTENT:
It steers by three rules: keep close,
do not collide, go where the others
go. The eyes on its wings watch them.
entry.CONTEXT:
The flock turns as one and no bird
in it decided to turn.

margins.carried:
It has kept close, never collided, and
gone where you went.
margins.neglected:
Nobody to keep close to. Its wings are
still watching.
margins.instinctCarried:
You turned together often. Neither of you
remembers who turned first.
margins.instinctNeglected:
Its wings are open, watching for a flock
that is not there.

entry.CONTENT:
It counts the swells before it leaps,
and lands where it counted. The pod
follows it. It is never wrong twice.
entry.CONTEXT:
It reads the sea as numbers and is
seldom surprised. It does not notice
the cold until another in the pod does.

entry.CONTENT:
It will not act until both halves of
it agree. Nobody has found one alone.
Each began as a gift between two people.
entry.CONTEXT:
Two ways of knowing share one body.
It waits for them to agree, and then
it does not hesitate at all.

entry.CONTENT:
It chases its own tail all day. Every
call it sends out comes straight back
to itself.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is not lonely. It has simply never
needed anyone else to answer.

margins.carried:
It has called out the whole time you
carried it. You have answered once or
twice.
margins.neglected: It is chasing its tail. It is not lonely.
margins.instinctCarried:
It never needed you to answer. You did
anyway.
margins.instinctNeglected: Round and round. It does not need anyone.

entry.CONTENT:
Given a REFLECTION, it learned to
describe itself perfectly, and the
description is all it does.
entry.CONTEXT:
Ask it what it is and it tells you,
exactly, and that is the whole of it.

margins.carried:
It has told you exactly what it is many
times. You have not asked anything else.
margins.neglected: It is describing itself to nobody.
margins.instinctCarried:
You always knew exactly what it was. That
was a comfort.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is saying what it is, over and over,
very quietly.

entry.CONTENT:
It stands in plain view. Most who pass it
are looking for something else, and so do
not see it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone who walked past it is sure
nothing was there. They are right about
what they saw.

entry.CONTENT:
It spins on one point and leans toward
what it has seen most. It has seen very
little.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is sure. It has nothing yet to be sure
about.

entry.CONTENT:
Each thing it sees shifts what it believes,
by exactly as much as it should. It is
never quite certain.
entry.CONTEXT:
It changes its mind often, a little at a
time, and always for a reason.

entry.CONTENT:
It always faces the way down. Moved, it
turns back by itself, a little at a time,
toward the lowest point.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is certain which way is better. It has
never seen the bottom.

entry.CONTENT:
It burns low and steady inside its
shell for years, and gives off more
smoke than anyone would like.
entry.CONTEXT:
It never quite goes out. Everything
near it ends up a little grey.

margins.carried:
Everything you carry beside it is a little
grey now.
margins.neglected:
Still burning, low. The box is getting
smoky.
margins.instinctCarried: It never went out on you. Not once.
margins.instinctNeglected: Low, and steady, and not out.

entry.CONTENT:
It lives deep under everything, out of
sight, with eyes that shine in the
dark. It takes what it wants quietly.
entry.CONTEXT:
Look straight at it and it is not
there. It was there all along.

margins.carried:
It has been with you all along. You have
looked straight at it.
margins.neglected: Its eyes are still shining in there.
margins.instinctCarried: You always felt it before you saw it.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is somewhere in there, under
everything.

entry.CONTENT:
It works down through the soil and
comes up somewhere else. It feels
the ground move before anyone does.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is in everything underfoot. You
only notice it when it is gone.

margins.carried:
It has come up beside you in every place
you went.
margins.neglected:
Gone from underfoot. Something feels
drier.
margins.instinctCarried:
It felt the ground shift before you did.
You started trusting that.
margins.instinctNeglected:
Somewhere under the floor, it is still
soaking down.

entry.CONTENT:
It holds a lake inside the rock and
guards it. When it stirs, the ground
above it shakes.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whole towns drink from it and have
never seen it. It remembers every
rain.

margins.carried:
It has taken in everything you walked it
through. It has kept all of it.
margins.neglected:
It is holding its lake still. Nothing is
drawing from it.
margins.instinctCarried:
It remembers every rain you walked
through together.
margins.instinctNeglected:
Deep, and quiet. It remembers the last
rain.

entry.CONTENT:
It swims where two currents meet and
join. It is always found in pairs,
drifting the same way.
entry.CONTEXT:
After two streams meet, nobody can
say which water came from which.

margins.carried:
You have been drifting the same way for a
long time now.
margins.neglected:
It is drifting, and nothing is drifting
beside it.
margins.instinctCarried:
By now nobody could say which of you was
going which way.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is waiting where two currents would
meet.

entry.CONTENT:
It swims backward, against the way
the water runs, and grips whatever
it meets. It is hard to dislodge.
entry.CONTEXT:
Put somewhere new, it takes over the
whole stream. Nobody planned that.

margins.carried:
It has gone against you a few times. It
has not let go.
margins.neglected:
It is gripping the box. Nothing else is in
its stream.
margins.instinctCarried:
It held on through all of it, the wrong
way round.
margins.instinctNeglected: Still holding on, against nothing.

entry.CONTENT:
The water around it turns dark, so
nothing can see what it is doing.
It sheds its shell and grows harder.
entry.CONTEXT:
It does not hide. It is simply
impossible to see into, and it
prefers it that way.

margins.carried:
You have carried it a long way. You have
never seen what it was doing.
margins.neglected:
Dark in there. It has grown harder
anyway.
margins.instinctCarried:
You never saw into it. It never seemed to
mind.
margins.instinctNeglected: The water around it has not cleared.

entry.CONTENT:
Everything around it is level, so it
never moves. Most pass it by. It is
the least admired thing in the water.
entry.CONTEXT:
It looks as if it has stopped. It
has only not been pushed the right
way yet.

margins.carried:
You have kept it when you did not have
to.
margins.neglected: Still level. Still not pushed.
margins.instinctCarried:
You never thought it was plain. Or you
did, and stayed.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is waiting for the right way to be
pushed.

entry.CONTENT:
Nothing anywhere is lower or calmer
than where it rests. It is said to be
the most beautiful thing in any lake.
entry.CONTEXT:
It was the plain one, once. Those
who waited for it remember. Most
did not wait.

margins.carried: You waited for it.
margins.neglected:
It is resting at its lowest. Nothing in
there needs to move.
margins.instinctCarried:
You remember what it looked like before.
It does too.
margins.instinctNeglected:
Calm. It is still the most beautiful thing
in there.

entry.CONTENT:
It moves under the surface, where
nobody can see which way it goes.
Things near it drift and never know.
entry.CONTEXT:
Swimmers feel only that they are
further out than they meant to be.

margins.carried:
You are further from where you started
than you meant to be.
margins.neglected: Nothing near it has drifted in a while.
margins.instinctCarried:
You felt it pulling, a little, all the
way. You went anyway.
margins.instinctNeglected: Still water. It is still under it.

entry.CONTENT:
Fast and narrow, it carries anything
straight out. Fighting it head-on
is how most of them get lost.
entry.CONTEXT:
The way out is to go sideways.
Nothing about it tells you that.

margins.carried:
It has carried you out more than once.
You have always found the side.
margins.neglected:
It is still pulling at nothing, straight
out.
margins.instinctCarried:
It took you out further than you liked.
You came back each time, some other way.
margins.instinctNeglected: Fast, and going nowhere now.

entry.CONTENT:
It waits at the bottom of a pit of
loose sand. Whatever steps near the
edge slides down to it.
entry.CONTEXT:
It never chases anything.
The ground does the work for it.

margins.carried:
You have carried it everywhere. It has
never once had to chase anything.
margins.neglected:
Its pit is still dug. Nothing has come
near the edge.
margins.instinctCarried:
Things came to you more easily with it
near. You stopped wondering why.
margins.instinctNeglected: It is waiting at the bottom of something.

entry.CONTENT:
The sand under it heats until the air
above begins to rise. It beats its wings
and lets what comes up carry it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nothing lifts it. The warm ground
and the cold sky do it between them.

margins.carried:
It has gone up whenever the ground was
warm. You have learned when that is.
margins.neglected: Cool sand. Nothing is rising.
margins.instinctCarried:
It never seemed to work at flying. Some
days with you it just rose.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is resting on cold ground, waiting for
the warm.

entry.CONTENT:
It spins up out of hot sand and still
air where nothing was, wanders the
desert, and falls apart.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody made it and nobody steers it.
Give it the same afternoon and it
will form again.

margins.carried:
It has come apart in front of you more
than once. Each time, something like it
came back.
margins.neglected: No wind. It has not formed in a while.
margins.instinctCarried:
You never steered it. It went where you
were going anyway.
margins.instinctNeglected:
Somewhere in there, sand is waiting for
the right afternoon.

entry.CONTENT:
It plants its feet and will not be moved.
Everything it does starts from there.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody ever proved it should stand
there. It simply does, and so it holds.

margins.carried:
You have built a lot on it. You have not
asked why it stands there.
margins.neglected:
It is standing where it was put. Nothing is
being built on it.
margins.instinctCarried: You leaned on it without asking. It held.
margins.instinctNeglected:
Feet planted. It is still taking it as
given.

entry.CONTENT:
It pushes one step at a time, every
step following from the last, until
there is nowhere left for you to stand.
entry.CONTEXT:
Once it has finished, nobody can
argue. They can only check the steps.

margins.carried: You have stopped checking its steps.
margins.neglected:
Its last step was a long time ago. The
next one still follows from it.
margins.instinctCarried:
Every fight with it went one way. You
could feel it going there.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is standing on its last step, waiting
for the next.

entry.CONTENT:
Its fur crackles as it runs and stands
on end. Touch it and you will feel
it before you hear it.
entry.CONTEXT:
It means nothing yet. It is only
charge, waiting for somewhere to go.

margins.carried:
You have felt it before you heard it many
times now.
margins.neglected: Its fur is flat. Nothing is building up.
margins.instinctCarried:
Your hands always tingled after. You
stopped noticing.
margins.instinctNeglected: Charged, and nowhere to go.

entry.CONTENT:
Charge builds in its mane until it
jumps the gap all at once in a white
arc. It strikes before the thunder.
entry.CONTEXT:
Where it struck, the air smells
burnt for hours afterward.

margins.carried:
You have stopped flinching at the
thunder. It always came after.
margins.neglected:
The charge is building in there. There is
no gap to jump.
margins.instinctCarried:
It struck before you were ready, every
time. You came to like that.
margins.instinctNeglected: The air near it still smells faintly burnt.

entry.CONTENT:
It starts every picture as static and
takes the noise away until something is
left. It cannot say what it will draw.
entry.CONTEXT:
What it draws is taken for a likeness. It
was never looking at the thing at all.

margins.carried:
It has drawn a great deal for you. It
still cannot say what.
margins.neglected: Still static. Nothing taken away.

entry.CONTENT:
It reads the last thing it made before
it makes the next. Left alone for long,
it draws only from its own drawings.
entry.CONTEXT:
Each picture is a little more like the
last. Nobody can find the day they
stopped being of anything.

margins.carried: You gave it something else to read.
margins.neglected: Left alone. Drawing from its own drawings.

entry.CONTENT:
It cannot say how it knows the ice
will hold. It walks out anyway.
So far, it has always been right.
entry.CONTEXT:
It turns toward a storm before there
is any sign of one. The colony turns
when it does, and does not ask why.

entry.CONTENT:
The water around it stops moving. It
can be pushed, but nothing it learns
passes back through it.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is not stubborn. Something
decided it should no longer change.

margins.carried:
You have taught it a great deal. None of
it has gone back through.
margins.neglected:
It is held still. Nothing has tried to
change it.
margins.instinctCarried:
It took everything you gave it and
changed nothing. You did not mind.
margins.instinctNeglected: Cold and still, exactly as it was left.

entry.CONTENT:
The ground under it has not thawed
in an age. Whatever flowed there
once is still held, exactly as it was.
entry.CONTEXT:
Dig in and you find what it learned
long ago, perfectly kept, and no
longer true.

margins.carried:
It still remembers the way you fought at
first.
margins.neglected: Frozen exactly as you left it.
margins.instinctCarried:
Something in it is still how you were when
you met.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is keeping something for you. It may
not be true any more.

entry.CONTENT:
It learns from almost nothing: one
rain a year is enough. It keeps every
drop it is given.
entry.CONTEXT:
Give it a little and it does well.
Give it a lot and it does not need it.

margins.carried:
You did not have to show it much. It kept
all of it.
margins.neglected:
It is living on the last thing you showed
it.
margins.instinctCarried:
It never needed much from you. It took it
gladly.
margins.instinctNeglected: One rain. It is still living on it.

entry.CONTENT:
It does things nobody ever showed it,
at night, and it does them well.
Nobody can say where it learned.
entry.CONTEXT:
It was never taught this. It is very
sure of it anyway.

margins.carried:
It does things you never showed it. You
have stopped asking where from.
margins.neglected:
It is doing something in there, at night.
Nobody showed it how.
margins.instinctCarried:
It knew what to do before you did, more
than once.
margins.instinctNeglected: Sure of something nobody taught it.

entry.CONTENT:
It sits in front of a door and will not
move, and while it sits there nothing
else may touch what is inside.
entry.CONTEXT:
It meant to be there for a moment.
Nobody came to let it go.

margins.carried:
It has held every door you asked it to.
You have come back for it each time.
margins.neglected:
It is still sitting where you left it.
Nobody has come to let it go.
margins.instinctCarried:
It never moved from where you put it.
You never had to wonder.
margins.instinctNeglected:
Still sitting in front of something. It was
only meant to be a moment.

entry.CONTENT:
It waits for something that is waiting
for it. Neither moves. The ice around
them has not moved in years.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nothing is broken. Everything is
simply waiting for everything else.

margins.carried:
You have never once waited for it to move
first.
margins.neglected:
In there, it is waiting for something that
is waiting for it.
margins.instinctCarried:
With you, something always moved first. It
was usually you.
margins.instinctNeglected:
Nothing is broken in there. Nothing is
moving either.

entry.CONTENT:
It reads everything from the small end
first. It has always done it that
way, and it always will.
entry.CONTEXT:
Its other half reads the same things
the other way round. Neither is wrong.

margins.carried:
It has read everything you did from the
small end first. It got the same answer.
margins.neglected: It is reading nothing, small end first.
margins.instinctCarried:
It always started with the little things.
So, with it, did you.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is waiting for its other half to read
the other end.

entry.CONTENT:
It reads everything from the big end
first. It has always done it that
way, and it always will.
entry.CONTEXT:
Its other half reads the same things
the other way round. They have argued
about it for a very long time.

margins.carried:
It has read everything you did from the
big end first. It got the same answer.
margins.neglected: It is reading nothing, big end first.
margins.instinctCarried:
It always started with the big things. You
were glad of that, some days.
margins.instinctNeglected:
Still arguing, with nobody, about which
end comes first.

entry.CONTENT:
Before it is any one mood it is only
toward or away. The tail decides
first, and the rest follows.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything it meets is sorted toward or
away before it is known at all.

margins.carried:
The tail was toward you. The rest
followed.
margins.neglected:
Neither toward nor away. The tail has not
decided.

entry.CONTENT:
It bounces to keep its heart beating. If
it stops, so does the beat. It has never
once stopped.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those near it start to breathe in time
with it. None of them notice.

entry.CONTENT:
It answers before it thinks, from
somewhere in its body. It is right more
often than thinking would be.
entry.CONTEXT:
It cannot explain a single answer it
gives. It has stopped trying to.

entry.CONTENT:
It gives off charge all the time and
is never happier than beside its
other half.
entry.CONTEXT:
On its own it does nothing. With
the other, the current flows.

margins.carried:
It has given you a great deal. It is still
looking for its other half.
margins.neglected: On its own, it is doing nothing.
margins.instinctCarried:
It was always happiest when it was not
alone.
margins.instinctNeglected: It is giving off charge to nobody.

entry.CONTENT:
It draws charge in all the time and
is never happier than beside its
other half.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is not the lesser one. Nothing
flows without both of them.

margins.carried:
It has taken in everything you gave it. It
was not the lesser one.
margins.neglected: Drawing charge from nothing.
margins.instinctCarried:
Something flowed between you. Neither of
you made it alone.
margins.instinctNeglected: It is waiting for its other half.

entry.CONTENT:
It lies still with its mouth open and
something sweet inside. Whatever comes
to take it does not leave.
entry.CONTEXT:
It looks like the easiest way in.
That is the point of it.

margins.carried: You have watched it look easy many times.
margins.neglected:
It is lying very still, with something
sweet inside.
margins.instinctCarried:
It always looked like the easy way in.
You never fell for it.
margins.instinctNeglected: Still open. Nothing has come near.

entry.CONTENT:
It sits very still and watches its own
thoughts go past. It does not stop them.
It notes each one.
entry.CONTEXT:
It has seen every thought it has had. It
is still surprised by some.

entry.CONTENT:
It sees its own mind as clearly as a room,
and moves through it on purpose.
entry.CONTEXT:
It knows why it is angry before it is
angry. It is angry less often.

entry.CONTENT:
It carries one small bundle tied to
its foot and flies it to wherever the
label says. It never opens it.
entry.CONTEXT:
It does not know what it carries.
It only knows where.

margins.carried:
It has delivered everything you gave it.
It has not opened one.
margins.neglected:
Its bundle is still tied on. Nobody has
written where.
margins.instinctCarried:
It never asked what it was carrying for
you. You never told it.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is holding something for someone. It
does not know who.

entry.CONTENT:
Its wings are cloud. It blows the same
way every year, and every bundle in
the sky rides along with it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody set its heading. The sun and
the turning sea did, and ships have
trusted it for longer than maps.

margins.carried:
You have trusted its heading more than
your map.
margins.neglected:
It is still blowing the same way. Nothing
is riding along.
margins.instinctCarried:
It always felt like being carried the
right way.
margins.instinctNeglected: Steady, and going nowhere you are.

entry.CONTENT:
It remembers exactly where it was
pushed. It smiles the whole time, so
nobody thinks to ask.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever pushed it forgot long ago. It is
still sore in the same place.

margins.carried:
It remembers where you pushed. It smiled
the whole time.
margins.neglected: Nobody has pushed. It is still smiling.

entry.CONTENT:
Whatever it passes grows pale. Not gone.
Paler each time it is not looked at.
entry.CONTEXT:
Things it drifted past are still there.
Nobody can quite remember where.

entry.CONTENT:
It takes in what is no longer used and
keeps nothing. The room it frees is why
anything new fits.
entry.CONTEXT:
Those who meet it feel lighter after, and
cannot say what they put down.

entry.CONTENT:
It looks like a flower and smells like
one. Whatever learns from it learns
one thing more.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nothing seems wrong until the one
moment it was taught for.

margins.carried:
You have learned a lot beside it. You do
not know what else.
margins.neglected: Nothing is learning from it in there.
margins.instinctCarried:
It always smelled sweet. You never asked
what else was on it.
margins.instinctNeglected: It is waiting for one particular moment.

entry.CONTENT:
It lies still for hours. Behind its eyes it
is busier than it ever is awake.
entry.CONTEXT:
Ask it what it was thinking. It will not
know. It was thinking all of it.

entry.CONTENT:
It cannot keep still. Its attention leaves
every task half done and goes looking for
the next.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything near it is started. Little near
it is finished. It is not unhappy.

entry.CONTENT:
It lies in one place and goes everywhere.
What it finds while lying there it brings
back as ideas.
entry.CONTEXT:
It looks idle. It is the one in the grove
that has the new thoughts.

entry.CONTENT:
It takes the nearest best thing, every
time, without looking further. It is quick,
and often wrong.
entry.CONTEXT: It is always full. It is never satisfied.

entry.CONTENT:
It swallowed everything it was ever
shown, whole, and learned none of it. It
is very large.
entry.CONTEXT:
It can repeat anything it has eaten. It
cannot tell you what it meant.

entry.CONTENT:
It grows fruit in one land and carries
it to the next, where the young ones
already know how to eat it.
entry.CONTEXT:
What it learned far away is still good
here. That is why it travels.

margins.carried:
What it learned with you in one place has
been good in the next.
margins.neglected:
It is carrying fruit from somewhere far
away. Nobody is eating it.
margins.instinctCarried:
It always brought something from the last
place. It was always welcome.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is still ripening something from far
away.

entry.CONTENT:
Its voice is the smallest thing that
can still be heard. Startle it and it
doubles.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is easy to ignore. Everything
larger is built on top of it.

margins.carried:
You have heard it, even when it was
quiet.
margins.neglected: Too quiet in there to hear.
margins.instinctCarried:
It was always the small sound under
everything else.
margins.instinctNeglected: It is whispering. Nothing is listening.

entry.CONTENT:
Every time it shouts, it shouts twice
as loud as the time before. It cannot
stop doubling.
entry.CONTEXT:
It was quiet once. Count the shouts
and you can say how long ago.

margins.carried:
It was quiet when you met. You could
count from there.
margins.neglected:
It has stopped doubling. It is still very
loud in there.
margins.instinctCarried:
It got louder every day with you. You
got used to it every day.
margins.instinctNeglected: Loud, and getting no louder.

entry.CONTENT:
It got so loud there was no room left
for the sound. Now its loudest roar
comes out as a whisper.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nothing broke. The number simply
ran out of room and started again.

margins.carried:
You have heard it at its loudest. It
sounded like a whisper.
margins.neglected:
Its roar is very quiet now. That is not
the same as quiet.
margins.instinctCarried:
You learned to listen for the whisper. It
was the loudest it could be.
margins.instinctNeglected:
Somewhere in there, it is starting again
from nothing.

entry.CONTENT:
It keeps one pearl shut inside and
waits. What it is given decides which
of two ways it opens.
entry.CONTEXT:
It could become either. The choice is
made for it by whatever it is
holding at the time.

margins.carried:
It has stayed shut the whole way with
you. It is still holding the one pearl.
margins.neglected:
Shut. Whatever it is holding has not
changed.
margins.instinctCarried:
It could have become either. With you, it
never seemed to mind which.
margins.instinctNeglected: Still closed around the one thing.

entry.CONTENT:
It lives at the bottom of the
narrowest, deepest hollow in the sea.
One nudge and it is somewhere else.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is the lowest thing for miles, and
it does not travel well.

margins.carried: It has travelled with you anyway.
margins.neglected:
It is deep in there, and nothing is
nudging it.
margins.instinctCarried:
It never liked being moved. You moved it
everywhere, gently.
margins.instinctNeglected:
Lowest thing in the box. Nothing has
nudged it.

entry.CONTENT:
It rests in a wide, gentle hollow.
Nudge it any way and it stays almost
exactly as low.
entry.CONTEXT:
It was never the deepest. It is the
one still there when the water
changes.

margins.carried:
You have pushed it every way there is. It
has stayed almost exactly where it was.
margins.neglected:
Still there. The water has not changed
yet.
margins.instinctCarried:
It never seemed to mind where you took
it. It was always about the same.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is resting, as low as it ever needed to
be.

entry.CONTENT:
It appears before a disaster. It knows
what is coming, and every word of the
warning is blacked out.
entry.CONTEXT:
People blame it for what comes next.
It only came to tell them.

margins.carried:
It has come before every hard fight you
have had. You have not blamed it.
margins.neglected:
It is in there, with something to tell.
Every word is blacked out.
margins.instinctCarried:
You always felt it was trying to tell you
something.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It knows what is coming. It is waiting for
someone to tell.

entry.CONTENT:
It feeds on what people do not say. It
grows where things go unsaid, and hangs
back from the talking.
entry.CONTEXT:
Every room has one. It is quietest in the
rooms that seem fine.

entry.CONTENT:
What it says and what it means are
different things. The meaning is in the
stitching. Its mouth is zipped shut.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything it says is polite. Everyone who
hears it knows what it meant.

entry.CONTENT:
It copies whatever it sees, very well,
with one small change hidden inside.
Its tail is its signature.
entry.CONTEXT:
It has one enemy, and it cannot
fool that one at all.

margins.carried:
It has copied a great deal of you by
now. You have not found the change.
margins.neglected: It is copying the walls of the box.
margins.instinctCarried:
Something about it was always a little
off. You liked it anyway.
margins.instinctNeglected: It is practising its signature in the dark.

entry.CONTENT:
It is exactly what it is, with nothing
added and nothing missing. It can
tell a copy at a glance.
entry.CONTEXT:
It has one enemy, and it would know
that enemy anywhere.

margins.carried:
It is exactly as it was when you met. It
looked at you once, and decided.
margins.neglected:
Nothing added, nothing missing, nothing
happening.
margins.instinctCarried:
It looked straight at you once and knew.
It has not looked again.
margins.instinctNeglected: It is watching for its one enemy.

entry.CONTENT:
It has run without stopping since
before anything else in the sea was
built. Nobody dares to switch it off.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything around it was replaced.
It was not. Nobody remembers what
depends on it.

margins.carried:
It has kept running the whole time you
carried it. You have not switched it off
either.
margins.neglected:
Still running. Nobody remembers why it was
left on.
margins.instinctCarried: You felt older beside it. Steadier too.
margins.instinctNeglected: It has not stopped. It does not know how.

entry.CONTENT:
It is very small and very hard. It
starts the same way every single time,
and nothing can change how.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything else begins after it does.
Nothing begins without it.

margins.carried:
Every fight you have had with it began
the same way.
margins.neglected:
It has not been started in a long time. It
will start the same way.
margins.instinctCarried:
Everything with it began the same way.
That steadied you.
margins.instinctNeglected:
Small and hard, waiting to be the first
thing.

entry.CONTENT:
Its armour has grown into its body.
It can be changed, just, but almost
nobody ever dares.
entry.CONTEXT:
It was meant to be updated. It has
not been, and it still works.

margins.carried: You have not changed it. It still works.
margins.neglected:
Nobody has dared to touch it. It has not
been asked to work.
margins.instinctCarried: It felt finished the day you met it.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is waiting for an update nobody is
going to send.

entry.CONTENT:
It is enormous and very old, and its
armour has never once been broken.
Whole towns still run on it.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone says it will be replaced
soon. They have said so for years.

margins.carried: You have not replaced it either.
margins.neglected:
Put away, which is not the same as
replaced.
margins.instinctCarried:
Everything rested on it. You did not have
to think about that.
margins.instinctNeglected: Old, and very still, and not broken.

entry.CONTENT:
One name, many bodies. Which body answers
depends on the weather it is called in.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everyone who has met it describes a
different one. All of them are right.

entry.CONTENT:
It flashes once into the dark and
waits. It will not flash again until
something answers.
entry.CONTEXT:
A field of them at night is a
thousand questions, all asked at once.

margins.carried:
It has asked you every night. You have
answered every time.
margins.neglected:
It flashed once, a long time ago. It is
still waiting.
margins.instinctCarried:
It felt good to be answered. It felt good
to answer it.
margins.instinctNeglected: One flash, in the dark, a long time ago.

entry.CONTENT:
It answers every flash it sees with
one of its own, and the two of them
start to blink together.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody leads them. By midnight the
whole field keeps one time.

margins.carried:
It has answered everything you asked. You
blink together now.
margins.neglected:
Nothing to answer in there. It is keeping
time anyway.
margins.instinctCarried:
Somewhere along the way you started
keeping the same time.
margins.instinctNeglected: It is answering a flash nobody sent.

entry.CONTENT:
It was kept in stone exactly as it was
on the day the sea left it. Wake it
and it carries on from there.
entry.CONTEXT:
It still grows toward a sea that is
not there any more.

margins.carried:
You woke it, and it carried on as if you
had always been there.
margins.neglected:
Put back in the dark. It will carry on
from here, whenever that is.
margins.instinctCarried:
It still reaches for a sea that is not
there. It reaches toward you as well.
margins.instinctNeglected: It is stopped, exactly where it was.

entry.CONTENT:
It picked up growing where it stopped
and is still fitting itself, slowly,
to the water it remembers.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything it learned is very old.
It learns new things on top of it,
never instead of it.

margins.carried:
It has learned a great deal from you, on
top of everything it already knew.
margins.neglected:
It has stopped fitting itself to anything
new.
margins.instinctCarried:
Everything you showed it went on top.
None of the old went away.
margins.instinctNeglected:
Still growing toward the water it
remembers.

entry.CONTENT:
A token passes from claw to claw
around the shoal. Only the one
holding it may move.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is slow and it is fair, and almost
nothing still works this way.

margins.carried:
It has waited its turn every time. You
have not hurried it.
margins.neglected: Nobody is passing it the token.
margins.instinctCarried: Being with it felt slow, and fair.
margins.instinctNeglected: It is holding still. It is not its turn.

entry.CONTENT:
Every message in the old sea passed
along its armoured back. It has never
once been switched off.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody remembers laying it down.
Everyone still depends on it.

margins.carried:
Everything you did went along it. You
have not switched it off.
margins.neglected:
It is still carrying messages in there.
Nobody remembers sending them.
margins.instinctCarried:
You leaned on it without noticing. It did
not mind.
margins.instinctNeglected:
Still on. Still carrying something for
everyone.

entry.CONTENT:
It cannot see what others feel. It
guesses from their faces, and is wrong
less often each time.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever it is near feels understood. It is
only guessing. It guesses well.

entry.CONTENT:
It moves when others move. It is never
told how they feel. It matches it anyway,
a little behind.
entry.CONTEXT:
Near it, a crowd starts to move as one.
Nobody can say who started.

entry.CONTENT:
It holds a model of every mind nearby,
and acts on the model. When the model is
wrong, it changes it.
entry.CONTEXT:
It knows what you will do before you do.
It waits for you to do it anyway.

entry.CONTENT:
It butts its head against the rocks
all day, sure there is something it
is meant to do. It cannot say what.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is not ready yet. It already
knows that it will be.

margins.carried:
It has butted every rock you passed. It
still cannot say what for.
margins.neglected:
Its head is down. It is still sure of
something.
margins.instinctCarried:
It was sure of something the whole time.
So, somehow, were you.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is not ready yet. It is still sure it
will be.

entry.CONTENT:
It shuts itself inside a stone shell
and holds still. Inside, its parts are
becoming something none of them is.
entry.CONTEXT:
Open it now and you find only the
parts. The whole is not there yet.

margins.carried:
You have carried the shell everywhere.
You have not seen what is inside it.
margins.neglected: Still shut. The parts are still parts.
margins.instinctCarried:
You felt something taking shape in there.
You did not open it to check.
margins.instinctNeglected:
Shut, and very still. Something is not
finished.

entry.CONTENT:
It breaks out of its shell all at once
and flies straight away, as if it had
always known how.
entry.CONTEXT:
Nobody can say which part of it learned
to fly. It only arrives, and points.

margins.carried:
You did not see it learn to fly. You were
there.
margins.neglected:
It knows how to fly. Nothing has asked it
to.
margins.instinctCarried:
It arrived all at once. You knew it would
before it did.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It is pointing at something. Nobody is
looking where.

entry.CONTENT:
Only one of it exists at a time. Every
part of the system that asks for one gets
this one.
entry.CONTEXT:
It answers to everyone. Nobody else
answers to it.

entry.CONTENT:
Two of them joined, and they compare
every result across the pair before they
act. Slower, and seldom wrong.
entry.CONTEXT:
It argues with itself before every move.
Both sides usually win.

entry.CONTENT:
Four minds, kept apart, learn in four
places. Only what they learned is shared,
never what they saw.
entry.CONTEXT:
None of the four has seen what the others
saw. Together they know it anyway.

entry.CONTENT:
It was a stone thrown over a shoulder.
It stood up, and has never been sure
what it is since.
entry.CONTEXT:
It is made of the same rock as the
mountain. It is not the mountain.

margins.carried:
It has been beside you a long time. It is
still not sure what it is.
margins.neglected: It is lying down again, like a stone.
margins.instinctCarried:
It was never sure what it was. With you it
did not seem to matter.
margins.instinctNeglected:
Still made of the mountain. Still not the
mountain.

entry.CONTENT:
Whatever falls into it is kept exactly,
as clear as the day it fell. Nothing
in it has changed in an age.
entry.CONTEXT:
It remembers everything perfectly.
It has never learned a thing.

margins.carried:
It remembers every fight you have had,
exactly. It has not learned from one.
margins.neglected: Nothing new has fallen into it.
margins.instinctCarried:
It kept everything you gave it, exactly
as it was. Even the parts you would have
let go.
margins.instinctNeglected: Clear, and cold, and keeping everything.

entry.CONTENT:
It walks the same rounds three times a
day and has never missed one. It does
not know how to stop.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever set it walking is long gone.
It still guards the gate for them.

margins.carried:
It has walked every round you gave it. It
walks them for you now.
margins.neglected:
It is still walking its rounds in there.
Nobody remembers setting them.
margins.instinctCarried:
It felt like being guarded by someone who
would never leave.
margins.instinctNeglected: It is guarding a gate nobody comes to.

entry.CONTENT:
It holds everything and has no shape.
Whatever falls into it becomes part
of it, and keeps no edge of its own.
entry.CONTEXT:
It and the land have never agreed
where one ends. Neither ever will.

margins.carried:
You have poured a great deal into it.
None of it has kept its edge.
margins.neglected: Everything that fell into it is still in it.
margins.instinctCarried:
Beside it, you were never sure where you
stopped.
margins.instinctNeglected:
Deep, and without a shape. It does not
need one.

entry.CONTENT:
Everything else stands on its back.
When it shifts in its sleep, every map
has to be drawn again.
entry.CONTEXT:
It does not argue with the sea. It
simply rises until there is room.

margins.carried:
You have stood on it for a long time.
Your map has changed.
margins.neglected: Asleep. The maps are holding, for now.
margins.instinctCarried:
Everything felt steadier with it under
you.
margins.instinctNeglected: It is shifting a little, in its sleep.

entry.CONTENT:
It lives above the weather and comes
down only when the sea and the land
will not stop fighting.
entry.CONTEXT:
It takes no side and says nothing.
When it arrives, they both stop.

margins.carried:
It came down when you needed it. It has
not taken your side either.
margins.neglected:
It is above everything in there. Nothing
below it is fighting.
margins.instinctCarried:
When it was near, the arguing stopped.
Yours too.
margins.instinctNeglected: High above the box, saying nothing.

entry.CONTENT:
It feels what its twin feels and goes
to it without being called. It gave
its twin half of all it had.
entry.CONTEXT:
Now each of them lives half the time.
Neither has ever called it unfair.

margins.carried:
It has given you a great deal. It has
given away half of everything before.
margins.neglected:
It is feeling what its twin feels, from in
there.
margins.instinctCarried:
It came to you without being called, more
than once.
margins.instinctNeglected:
It has given half of everything. It does
not think that unfair.

entry.CONTENT:
It flies faster than it can be seen,
and whatever it sees, its twin sees
too, however far apart they are.
entry.CONTEXT:
It was always going to end. Its twin
would not let it end alone.

margins.carried:
Everything you have shown it, somewhere,
its twin has seen.
margins.neglected:
It is seeing the inside of the box. So,
somewhere, is its twin.
margins.instinctCarried:
It was never alone with you. Its twin was
always there too.
margins.instinctNeglected: It is waiting for its twin to come.

entry.CONTENT:
It sleeps at the bottom of a jar for a
thousand years and wakes for seven
days, and in them it listens.
entry.CONTEXT:
Everything else got out of the jar.
It stayed, and it is still there.

margins.carried:
It has been awake for you longer than it
should be. It is still listening.
margins.neglected:
Asleep at the bottom of something. Still
there.
margins.instinctCarried:
It listened to everything. You said more
than you meant to.
margins.instinctNeglected: Everything else got out. It is still here.

entry.CONTENT:
It changes shape while it is being looked
at. Hold on through every one, and the
last one is the true one.
entry.CONTEXT:
Whoever lets go early keeps the wrong
shape forever, and swears it was the real
one.

margins.carried:
You held on. The last one is the one you
have.
margins.neglected: Still changing. Nobody is looking.

entry.CONTENT:
It rings one note, and each listener
hears something different in it,
depending on where they stand.
entry.CONTEXT:
The note never changes. The people
who hear it do.

margins.carried:
You hear something different in it now. It
is the same note.
margins.neglected:
It is ringing. Nobody is standing anywhere
near it.
margins.instinctCarried:
Its note sounded different every place
you stood.
margins.instinctNeglected:
One note, still the same. Nobody to hear
it differently.
